title: Public Health Program Director 1 (66312)
description: Consultant: Strategic Planning, Technical Writing, -, Start date: 10/12/2026 End Date : 06/30/2027 Submission deadline: 09/18/2026 Client Info: TN DOH Note: *Hybrid. *Typical working hours - Monday - Friday, 8AM to 4:30PM CST, 37.5 hours per week. Not eligible for overtime. Description: The Tennessee Department of Healths Division of Family Health and Wellness (FHW) is seeking a contract Adolescent Health Program Coordinator to provide statewide leadership for adolescent health initiatives that improve the health and well-being of Tennessees youth. Under general supervision, this position leads the planning, implementation, coordination, and evaluation of adolescent health programs through collaboration with state and local partners, schools, healthcare providers, youth-serving organizations, and adolescents. The Adolescent Health Program Coordinator serves as the subject-matter expert for adolescent health and positive youth development, ensuring that youth perspectives inform public health strategies and programs. This position leads the development and implementation of Tennessees Adolescent Health Strategic Plan, provides leadership for statewide initiatives, develops partnerships, manages grants and projects, provides technical assistance, and supports data-informed decision-making to improve adolescent health outcomes across Tennessee. Key Responsibilities: • Lead the development, implementation, and evaluation of Tennessees Adolescent Health Strategic Plan, ensuring alignment with state and federal priorities and advancing coordinated adolescent health efforts across Tennessee. • Provide statewide leadership for adolescent health initiatives that promote healthy youth development and improve health outcomes for adolescents across Tennessee. • Develop, implement, manage, and evaluate adolescent health programs and initiatives. • Lead coordination of the Sources of Strength suicide prevention program in Tennessee by collaborating with implementing schools, community organizations, and local and national trainers to ensure the program is implemented with fidelity. • Lead the statewide implementation of Screenagers: Under the Influence, including project planning, coordination, partner engagement, implementation, evaluation, technical assistance, and reporting to TDH leadership and funding agencies. • Lead the support of Tennessee Generations (TNGen) by facilitating meetings, developing youth leadership opportunities, maintaining communication with members, coordinating youth-led initiatives, and supporting federal reporting requirements. • Coordinate adolescent engagement strategies, including advisory groups, focus groups, and other opportunities that ensure youth perspectives are incorporated into program planning, implementation, and evaluation. • Serve as the Maternal and Child Health Block Grant (MCHBG) Social Emotional Well-Being Priority Lead and coordinate activities in collaboration with the Domain Lead. • Build and sustain partnerships with schools, healthcare providers, community organizations, youth-serving agencies, and other partners to advance adolescent health priorities. • Identify emerging adolescent health needs and implement effective strategies related to positive youth development, healthy relationships, sexual health education, pregnancy prevention, dating violence prevention, nutrition, physical activity, and other factors that influence adolescent health and well-being. • Provide technical assistance, consultation, and training to internal and external partners on adolescent health best practices. • Monitor program performance, evaluate outcomes, analyze data, and use findings to support continuous program improvement. • Develop grant applications, progress reports, presentations, and other required state and federal reports. • Represent the Tennessee Department of Health on statewide

title: Attorney - 66316
description: Consultant: Microsoft Word, Written And Verbal Communication Skills, -, Start date :10/12/2026 End Date :09/30/2030 Submission deadline :9/15/2026 Client Info :TN DOH Note: Position Location: Hybrid Description: We are seeking an attorney to serve as a Contractor Associate General Counsel to assist the Departments effort to strengthen Tennessees rural healthcare infrastructure by supporting the effective regulation of healthcare professionals serving residents throughout the states 89 rural counties. This position reports to a Deputy General Counsel. The primary role of this position is the handling of disciplinary cases against healthcare licensees practicing in rural Tennessee counties, which includes working with Department investigators and licensing board consultants during the investigative and review process, negotiating resolution with licensees who have violated their respective practice acts, and trying cases before licensing boards. As assigned, job responsibilities may also include advising on special projects and conducting bill analysis related to the delivery of rural healthcare in Tennessee. Position requires weekly in-office time. This is a contract position not eligible for state employee benefits, and the successful candidate should obtain their own professional liability insurance. Key Responsibilities: - Represent the department in administrative law cases before various health-related boards. - Review complaints and investigations involving healthcare licensees practicing in any of Tennessees 89 rural counties. - Provide legal support for department investigators and licensing board consultants. - For those cases for which formal discipline is warranted, handle all aspects of litigation, including discovery, motion practice, and trials. - Ability to competently manage a robust case load at various phases of litigation. - Assist with legislative projects as assigned, including bill analysis. Minimum Qualifications: The ideal candidate should have litigation experience that includes trials, the ability to manage and prioritize a large volume of work, excellent verbal and written communication skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to collaborate and work in a team environment. Education: JD, admitted to TN Bar with a license in good standing required. At least 1 year of relevant legal experience preferred. Items to include with application: Please include with application a writing sample of not more than 10 pages along with the applicants TN Bar license number.

title: DBHDS - Data Governance Analyst (CDC Funded) (807900)
description: Analyst: Data Analysis, Proficiency In Sql, datawarehouse, Requirements Elicitation Relational Data Start date :10/05/2026 End Date :10/15/2027 Submission deadline :9/15/2026 Deadline to submit: By 4 pm EST on Tuesday 9/15 Client Info : DBHDS Note: * Work Arrangement: Hybrid * Agency Interview Type: Both Web Cam and In Person Interview Description: Work Location: Richmond, Virginia (Hybrid) Onsite: Two (2) days per week Duration: Nine (9 -12) months with possible extension Expected Start Date: Two (2) weeks after offer accepted Parking: Parking is not provided for contractors The Office of Data Governance is seeking an experienced Data Governance Analyst to support implementation of the agencys Enterprise Data Governance Program. The analyst will work closely with Data Owners, Data Stewards, Business Owners, Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineers, Project Teams, and Information Security to establish trusted, governed enterprise data supporting both operational and analytical use cases. This role focuses on governance activities supporting enterprise data ingested into the AWS Data Platform and consumed through Snowflake. The successful candidate will help establish governance processes, metadata, business rules, data quality standards, and stewardship practices while supporting the agencys growing enterprise data platform. * REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Minimum 10 years of experience in Data Governance, Data Management, Data Quality, Business Analysis, Metadata Management, or related disciplines. Experience implementing enterprise Data Governance programs. Experience facilitating governance workshops with business and technical stakeholders. Strong SQL skills for data analysis and validation. Experience documenting metadata, business glossaries, and data dictionaries. Experience defining business rules and Critical Data Elements (CDEs). Experience performing data profiling, reconciliation, and validation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Experience with several of the following technologies: Amazon Web Services (AWS) S3 Glue Glue Data Catalog Lake Formation Snowflake Python SQL Power BI SharePoint Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, Medicaid, or Virginia state government is highly desirable. * KEY RESPONSIBILITIES The successful candidate will: Data Governance Support implementation of the DBHDS Enterprise Data Governance Program. Facilitate governance workshops with business stakeholders. Support onboarding of new applications into the Enterprise Data Governance Program. Partner with Data Owners and Data Stewards to establish governance for new enterprise datasets. Develop and maintain governance policies, standards, procedures, and supporting documentation. * Metadata Management Capture and maintain business metadata, technical metadata, and data dictionaries. Develop and maintain the Enterprise Business Glossary. Define and document Critical Data Elements (CDEs). Map business metadata to technical metadata. Support metadata ingestion into the enterprise metadata repository. * Data Quality Define business data quality rules. Support data profiling and business validation activities. Monitor data quality metrics and trends. Assist Data Stewards with remediation planning. Perform reconciliation and validation across enterprise data sources. * Data Lineage & Architecture Document busine

===============================================================
🎯 PROJECT SUMMARY & OBJECTIVE
===============================================================
Position Purpose:

We are seeking a Web Accessibility Consultant to support the Departments efforts to create, remediate, test, and maintain accessible electronic documents and forms intended for publication or distribution. The consultant must be able to improve the accessibility and semantic structure of official DCS documents while preserving the documents substantive content, meaning, terminology, legal requirements, and policy intent.

===============================================================
📋 KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
===============================================================
• The consultant will work closely with the DCS Policy team to ensure electronic documents are developed and remediated in accordance with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, 2.2, Level AA, applicable PDF/UA requirements, DCS document standards, and established digital accessibility practices.
• The successful candidate will have the following skills and experience:
• WCAG 2.1, 2.2, Level AA requirements applicable to electronic documents.
• PDF/UA requirements, accessible PDF structure, and PDF tagging.
• Advanced Microsoft Word accessibility, including Styles, Headings, Lists, Tables, Hyperlinks, Images, Document Properties, and accessible PDF conversion.
• Adobe Acrobat Pro accessibility remediation, including Tags, Reading Order, Tables, Links, Figures, Document Properties, and Form Fields.
• Creating and remediating accessible fillable PDF Forms, including Field Labels, Tab Order, Radio Buttons, Checkboxes, Instructions, Keyboard Navigation, and Screen-Reader Usability.
• Establishing logical document structure, heading hierarchy, reading order, and navigation.
• Creating meaningful hyperlink text and appropriate alternative text.
• Properly identifying decorative images and other content that should not be announced by assistive technology.
• Remediating complex tables and recognizing when information would be more accessible if restructured as headings, lists, or paragraphs.
• Using automated accessibility checkers including WebAIM Contrast Checker, WAVE, ANDI, Color Contrast Analyzer, and NVDA.
• Performing manual accessibility testing.
• Key Duties and Responsibilities:
• Review and remediate DCS policy documents, protocol documents, fillable forms, and other related documents for accessibility.
• Create accessible Microsoft Word source documents and convert them to accessible PDFs when required.
• Remediate existing PDFs to meet applicable WCAG 2.1, 2.2, AA and PDF/UA requirements.
• Create or remediate accessible electronic forms, with special attention to Form Fields, Labels, Instructions, Grouping, Tab Order, and Keyboard Navigation.
• Conduct automated and manual accessibility testing, including review of document structure, reading order, forms, tables, links, images, and navigation.
• Perform quality-control reviews of remediated documents before publication.
• Assist with development or refinement of accessible Word and form templates.
• Identify recurring accessibility issues and recommend practices that reduce the need for future remediation.

===============================================================
🛠️ REQUIRED TECHNICAL PROFICIENCIES
===============================================================
• WCAG 2.1
• Advanced MS Word
• Adobe Acrobat

===============================================================
🌟 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & DOMAIN SKILLS
===============================================================
• Experience using PAC (PDF Accessibility Checker), the Matterhorn Protocol, or comparable PDF/UA testing methods is strongly preferred.

• Complete ITSM tickets within 7 - 10 business days.
• Monitor the ITSM IT Asset Management queue on a daily basis.
• Updating notes with clear and accurate information to insure that the life cycle of the ticket accurately captured.
• Correctly Managing ITAM Queue
• Assist With Asset IMAC and PC Refresh process

• Assist in tracking and maintain software licenses Perform periodic software audit of installs on desktops, servers, network equipment.

• Software License Management	Required	1	Years
• Inventory Auditing	Required	1	Years

title: Fleet/Facilities Technical Coordinator
description:
• The Temporary Employee will provide short-term operational and administrative support to the Fleet/Facilities Asset Section. 
• Work will focus on maintaining daily continuity for fleet and facility-related activities, including communication, tracking, documentation, data updates, and coordination with internal teams, Regional staff, vendors, and other stakeholders.
• Primary duties may include supporting motor pool and Agile Fleet-related activities, maintaining and updating fleet order or asset tracking tools, organizing records and documentation, assisting with asset inventory and tagging information, supporting surplus and delivery tracking, and helping monitor follow-up items related to fleet acquisition, warranties, invoices, and operational requests. 
• The position will also assist with preparing or updating standard operating procedures, communication materials, status updates, and other records needed to support consistent program operations.
• The role requires strong communication, organization, attention to detail, responsiveness, and the ability to adapt to changing daily priorities in an operational environment. 
• Because of the limited three-month timeframe, the Temporary Employee should be able to quickly learn existing processes, manage assigned tasks with minimal oversight, and provide dependable support to help maintain continuity of Fleet/Facilities services.

Qualifications

• Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in business, administration, or other related field.
• 3 years of demonstrated competency experience in maintenance, fleet/facility operations, or a related technical discipline.

OR

• Education equivalent to graduation from high school
• 5 years of demonstrated competency in maintenance or related technical discipline.

AND

• Ability to communicate clearly, respond to inquiries promptly, and provide organized customer service to internal and external stakeholders.
• Experience maintaining accurate records, documentation, audit information, or compliance-related files.
• Experience coordinating with internal teams, regional staff, vendors, or cross-functional stakeholders.
• Experience supporting fleet, facility, maintenance, asset management, or related technical operations.
• Experience with asset inventory, asset tagging, asset tracking, or maintaining asset records in a database/system.
• Working knowledge of dashboards, reports, data collection, or data analysis to support operational decision-making.
• Experience reviewing invoices, purchase orders, contracts, warranty information, delivery terms, or asset-related financial records.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
• The Client is seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer (Sr NE) to implement and provide support to the agency’s IT Network infrastructure. 
• The Sr NE performs day-to-day activities related to the support, documentation, research, analysis, and implementation of Network related infrastructure.
• Candidate must have in-depth, considerable knowledge and hands-on experience understanding, documenting, and maintaining Network related infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:

• Considerable knowledge and working experience with enterprise routers, switches, VPN concentrators, firewalls, wireless access points, and load balancers (including the ability to document, set up, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot)
• Be capable of troubleshooting Network related infrastructure.
• Identifies and diagnoses system problems by using line monitors, diagnostic software, test equipment.
• Works closely with agency’s IT infrastructure suppliers and stakeholders to gather requirements, specifications, and configurations to assure they are accurate and up to date.
• Responsible for assisting in troubleshooting and resolving network issues impacting application performance and uptime.
• Assist in overseeing the installation, documentation, and upgrades of various agency facility data network infrastructure.
• Will oversee and collaborate with cloud and DevSecOps teams to optimize hybrid connectivity and SDWAN configurations.
• Must have the ability to provide documentation, network architecture topology diagrams, IP schemes, firewall rules, and access controls when required.
• Must have the ability to work independently on assigned projects. 
• Must have minimally obtained an industry standard networking certification (example: Cisco CCNA, Juniper JNCIA- Junos, etc.)

 Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Considerable knowledge and hands-on working experience with enterprise routers, switches, VPN concentrators, firewalls, and wireless access points.	Required	8	Years
• Considerable hands-on working experience setting up, configuring, upgrading, managing and troubleshooting routers/switches, and WAPS.	Required	8	Years
• Demonstrated and hands-on ability to design, install and troubleshoot local-area and wide-area enterprise networks.	Required	8	Years
• Considerable direct hands-on experience engineering and design experience in networking industry required.	Required	8	Years
• Industry standard networking certification (example: Cisco CCNA, Juniper JNCIA- Junos, etc.)	Required		
• In-depth experience designing installing and troubleshooting local-area and wide-area enterprise networks.	Required	8	Years
• Experience monitoring IT environments for compliance with information security, architecture policies, and standards.	Required	8	Years
• Experience creating repeatable, reliable, scalable network architectures with fault tolerance.	Required	8	Years
• Experience performance tuning, monitoring systems, statistics/metrics collection, and disaster recovery.	Required	8	Years
• Experience creating network diagrams using industry standard tools such as Visio, etc.	Required	8	Years
• Experience with networking features and protocols such as: ARP, CDP, EIGRP, OSPF, BGP, VTP, Etherchannel, HSRP, QoS, multicast, IPsec, etc	Required	8	Years
• Experience working with SDWAN	Desired	3	Years
• Experience working with network topology related to Cloud	Desired	3	Years
• Familiarity and experience working with cloud networking	Desired	3	Years

title: Business Analyst
description:
• The Client is seeking candidate for documenting home-grown systems in IFA\IEDA\ITG for future modernization.
• The Client is focused on modernizing its Medicaid and Integrated Eligibility Systems to enable faster policy and program changes, improve continuity of operations, and reduce brittle point-to-point dependencies. 
• Currently, data passes through multiple legacy systems with several weak links, leading to data reconciliation failures, downstream impacts, and manual workarounds. 
• To address these challenges, the Customer would like to engage with Google Cloud Professional Services (PSO) to establish a governed enterprise integration and data foundation. 
• This initial phase will focus on establishing a Cloud Foundation for a FedRAMP Moderate environment, providing a data integration platform, an application modernization strategy, performing a mainframe assessment, providing a product backlog, and defining program governance. 
• Ultimately, this effort aims to configure a modern Google Cloud application platform, allowing for incremental modernization while designing infrastructure aligned with Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) baseline requirements.

Responsibilities of business analyst role include but are not limited to:

•  Creating, presenting and maintaining user stories, acceptance criteria, demo expectations and design documents in the Client's defined systems.
•  Creating/documenting, tracing, maintaining, prioritizing, and assessing changes to business processes and the associated requirements
•  Working closely with key decision makers, systems owners and end users in support of core processes and critical business objectives
•  Conducting research to obtain data, analyzing problems to advise and recommend solutions
•  Querying and analyzing data to determine solutions, such as installation of alternate methods and procedures, changes in processing methods and practices, or redesign of products or services
•  Advising client or department heads on alternate methods of solving needs or problems, and recommending specific solutions
•  Working within an agile methodology framework with a focus on delivering value and adjusting rapidly to produce the most effective outcome
•  Working closely with all IT organizations and driving projects to successful completion
• A successful candidate for this role is expected to possess the following skills and experience:
•  Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact with a diverse group of team members, including executives, managers, IT professionals, and subject matter experts
•  Experience in process mapping, group facilitation, data gathering and analysis, and phases of project life cycle (requirements gathering, design, development, deployment, training, and measuring effectiveness.)
•  Experience delivering software as part of an agile delivery team
•  Strong ability to work effectively within time constraints, changing priorities, and independently
•  Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Visio
•  Experience with requirement gathering software such as Azure DevOps, TFS, JIRA, or RTC.
•  Analyze business strategy and user needs, document specifications, and translate business objectives into proper system requirement specifications
•  Guide business customers through business case development for new applications/functionality, including cost / benefit analysis and risk / impact analysis
•  Understanding of how to deliver value through realizations of benefits, avoidance of cost, identify new opportunities and modernizing the organization
•  Focus on continuous improvement for both the business process and the underlying technologies and system support
•  Strong ability to decompose complex concepts into smaller tasks while maintaining end-to-end business process focus
•  Work closely with other Business Units to identify and deliver Enterprise value
•  Experience providing consulting services to governmental entities
•  Skilled at consulting with executive-level stakeholders to define business needs or problems

Requirements

•  Experience working on large, complex IT systems (8 years)
• Experience eliciting requirements, writing user stories and design documents, defining acceptance criteria, testing outcomes, and facilitating communication between business stakeholders, developers,  and project teams. (8 years)
•  Experience with SDLC procedures and system development methodologies. (8 years)
•  Experience managing stakeholder expectations and priorities. (8 years)
•  Experience working within a project governance structure (methodology, required templates, and reporting). (8 years)
•  Excellent task management skills. Ability to balance and manage multiple tasks, with changing priorities, in a cross-functional environment. (8 years)
•  Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, and project activities, simultaneously, while meeting established deadlines. (8 years)
•  Experience with Microsoft development platforms and software. (8 years)
•  Experience in an Agile environment. (6 years)
•  Experience with Application Lifecycle Management [ALM] tools; Microsoft’s Team Foundation Server (TFS), Visual Studio Team Services (VSTS), Azure DevOps (ADO), Atlassian’s Jira, IBM’s Rational Team Suite (RTC). (5 years)
•  Working experience with Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio or other relational database software. (5 years)
•  Familiarity with advanced information management practices, data modeling standards, and/or architecture design and analysis. (3 years)
•  Bachelor’s degree in management information systems, Business, or related field, and/or relevant experience (8 years)

title: Senior Full-Stack .NET Modernization Developer
description:
• Under general supervision, designs, codes, tests, modifies and debugs computer software.

       What This Role Actually Is 

• Client's core licensing platform is a mission-critical application that supports child care licensing, provider management, and program eligibility across the Georgia. We are in the middle of a major modernization effort, moving from a legacy ASP.NET architecture to .NET 8+, modern APIs, Azure cloud services, and a React-based user experience. This is not a maintenance or production support role. 
• This position is for a senior engineer who wants to lead modernization efforts, solve complex technical problems, and help shape the future architecture of a statewide platform. 
• You will play a key role in technical design decisions, application architecture, cloud integration, and delivery. 
• Our team is intentionally lean. That means ownership matters. You will be expected to take a solution from concept to production, including design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and operational support. Success in this role requires initiative, accountability, and the ability to work independently. 
• If you're looking for a highly structured environment where work is narrowly defined and tasks are handed to you step-by-step, this is probably not the right fit. If you enjoy building, leading, and owning outcomes, you'll thrive here. . 

       What You Will Do 

• Application Modernization (Core of this Role) 
• Champion the modernization of client's mission-critical licensing and eligibility applications, transitioning legacy solutions to modern .NET and Azure-based architectures. 
• Design and implement scalable, secure, and maintainable application solutions that reduce technical debt and improve long-term supportability. 
• Build and evolve API-first integrations and services that enable future platform capabilities. 
• Develop cloud-native solutions using Azure App Services, Azure Functions, and related Azure technologies. 
• Own the SQL Server platform, including data architecture, performance tuning, data migration, and platform modernization. 
• Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps to automate testing, deployment, and release management. 
• Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, automation, documentation, and adherence to modern development practices. 

       Frontend & Integration 

• Build and maintain React-based UI components as part of the modernization roadmap 
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of web application rendering patterns, including client side rendering (CSR), server-side rendering (SSR), component-based architectures, and modern frontend frameworks. 
• Integrate third-party services and internal APIs; document every integration cleanly 
• Implement and maintain reporting using SSRS and Power BI 
• Participate in AI integration initiatives — Azure Agentic AI services, Copilot tooling, and chatbot integrations where applicable 

       Quality, Documentation & Support 

• Write code that your teammates can read and maintain six months from now 
• Provide production support and own root-cause analysis when things break 
• Maintain application documentation, deployment runbooks, and user-facing guides 
• Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and sprint ceremonies 

       Required Qualifications 

       EXPERIENCE 

• 8+ years of professional .NET development experience — C#, ASP.NET MVC, Web API 
• Demonstrated, hands-on experience migrating legacy ASP.NET applications to modern .NET (6, 7, 8 or 10) — not just exposure 
• Production SQL Server experience: stored procedures, T-SQL tuning, schema migrations, data cleanup 
• Azure hands-on: App Services, Function Apps, deployment pipelines, configuration management 
• 5+ years delivering software in Agile (Scrum or Kanban) environments using ADO or GitHub 

       WHAT HANDS-ON MEANS HERE 

• You have modernized a real application — not a proof of concept — from legacy ASP.NET to .NET 6/7/8/10 
• You have designed and maintained RESTful APIs that external systems depend on 
• You have debugged production issues independently, without a team lead walking you through it 

       Preferred Qualifications 

• These will make you effective faster. They are not dealbreakers, but they distinguish competitive candidates. 
• React experience — specifically building components within an existing application, not greenfield Exposer to .NET 10 
• Power BI or SSRS reporting development 
• Experience with government, healthcare, or public-sector systems — you understand compliance, auditability, and data sensitivity 
• Familiarity with ADA/WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards 
• Exposure to Azure Agentic AI services or integration of AI-driven features in production applications 
• Experience with middleware platforms such as Boomi or MuleSoft 
• Background working with PII data and the security protocols that protect it 

       Education 

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field — or equivalent work experience that demonstrates the same depth 

       What We Value Beyond the Technical 

• This team works on systems that affect real families in Georgia. We move fast because the mission requires it, but we do not cut corners on security, accessibility, or data integrity. 
• Ownership: You finish what you start and you tell people early when something is at risk 
• Directness: You surface problems with a proposed fix, not just a flag 
• Clarity under pressure: You can explain a technical constraint to a non-technical stakeholder without condescending or drowning them in jargon 
• Adaptability: Government systems change scope. Requirements shift. You adjust without drama

title: SR. IT Business Analyst
description:
Under general supervision, analyzes customer business needs and participates in the planning, design and implementation of new or enhanced systems.

The Senior Business Analyst for KOALA is responsible for analyzing business needs and supporting the planning, design, and implementation of new or enhanced systems for the client. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for KOALA, providing guidance to Child Care  Services (CCS), Legal/CRC units, the client application development team, and third-party vendors. The position also supports KOALA production activities, enhancements, and testing. 

Core Responsibilities 

• Ensure KOALA application functionality, requirements, and industry standards are accurately defined and implemented. 
• Serve as the primary subject matter expert for KOALA program operations. 
• Coordinate KOALA maintenance and support activities, representing agency interests. 
• Develop detailed business requirements and system documentation. 
• Assist CCS with creating KOALA user training materials, including screenshots and guidance. 
• Develop and execute test plans; support user acceptance testing and data preparation. 
• Participate in KOALA enhancement projects through the full project lifecycle, from definition through evaluation. 
• Build collaborative partnerships with internal teams and external vendors to ensure timely and successful deliverables. 
• Fulfill data requests as needed. 
Technical Skills & Competencies 

• Experience managing IT projects and writing business requirements. 
• Strong self-starter who can work independently. 
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
• Ability to communicate effectively with CCS and Legal staff. 
• Strong command of English grammar, punctuation, and writing conventions. 
• Ability to quickly understand and translate stakeholder needs. 
• Receptive to direction, feedback, and editing. 
• Logical, analytical, and detail-oriented. 
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Balsamiq, Azure DevOps, and SQL scripting. 
Physical Requirements 

• Ability to receive and understand information through oral communication. 
• Clear, effective verbal communication. 
• Ability to hear and understand normal conversation levels. 
• Close visual acuity for data analysis, transcription, computer work, reading, and visual inspection. 
• Ability to review, categorize, prioritize, and analyze data using discretion and judgment. 
• Ability to apply evaluative reasoning in situations requiring subjective analysis. 
Preferred Qualifications 

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field with 10+ years of relevant experience.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Job Description

The client is seeking an experienced Business Analyst to support operations at the State Hospital. This role will partner with clinical, operational, and IT stakeholders to gather, document, and translate business requirements into actionable project deliverables within a state psychiatric health facility environment. The position operates within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) delivery model and requires direct, on-site engagement with facility staff and leadership.

Key Responsibilities

•  Elicit, document, and validate business and functional requirements from clinical, administrative, and IT stakeholders at the State Hospital.
• Translate business requirements into user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria suitable for Agile/SAFe delivery teams.
• Facilitate requirement-gathering sessions, workshops, and interviews with subject matter experts across clinical and operational departments.
• Analyze current-state business processes within the psychiatric health facility and identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
• Maintain requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring alignment between documented needs and delivered solutions.
• Participate in SAFe ceremonies (PI Planning, sprint reviews, backlog refinement) as the business analysis representative for assigned initiatives.
• Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and technical teams to prioritize and refine the product backlog.
• Prepare clear, accurate documentation, including business requirement documents (BRDs), process maps, and status reporting for agency leadership.
• Support user acceptance testing (UAT) by developing test scenarios tied to documented requirements and validating outcomes with stakeholders.
Required Technical Skills

• Minimum 5 years of experience in business requirement within a psychiatric health facility or comparable behavioral health/clinical care setting.
• Demonstrated experience working within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, including familiarity with SAFe ceremonies and artifacts.
• Strong requirements elicitation, documentation, and process-mapping skills (e.g., BRDs, user stories, workflow diagrams).
• Experience facilitating stakeholder workshops and translating clinical/operational needs into actionable technical requirements.
• Proficiency with standard business analysis and collaboration tools (e.g., Microsoft Office/365, Visio, Jira, Confluence, or equivalent).
Preferred Qualifications

• SAFe certification (e.g., SAFe Practitioner, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or equivalent).
• Prior experience supporting IT or process-improvement initiatives within a state government or public-sector healthcare environment.
• Familiarity with behavioral health/psychiatric care operations, regulatory requirements, or electronic health record (EHR) systems.
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Health Administration, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Standard Job Duties:

• Gather, document, and analyze business requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and observations.
• Translate business needs into clear and concise technical specifications for development teams.
• Develop process flows, use cases, and data models to support solution design.
• Collaborate with project managers, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure successful implementation of solutions.
• Conduct gap analysis to identify areas for process improvement and optimization.
• Assist in the development and execution of test plans to validate solutions meet business requirements.
• Provide support during user acceptance testing (UAT) and ensure feedback is incorporated into final solutions.
• Create and maintain documentation, including business requirements, functional specifications, and user manuals.
• Monitor project progress and deliver updates to stakeholders.
• Stay informed about industry trends, tools, and best practices to enhance business analysis processes.
Required Skills:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to interpret business needs and create effective solutions.
• Proficiency in business analysis tools such as JIRA, Confluence, or Microsoft Visio.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills for stakeholder engagement and documentation.
• Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall project management methodologies.
• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively.
• Basic technical knowledge of software development, databases, or systems integration is a plus.
Recommended Education and Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in business administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
• 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role.
• Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or PMI-PBA are desirable.
• Experience working with enterprise-level systems and applications is a plus.

  • Translate business requirements into user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria suitable for Agile/SAFe delivery teams.

  • Analyze current-state business processes within the psychiatric health facility and identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring alignment between documented needs and delivered solutions.
  • Participate in SAFe ceremonies (PI Planning, sprint reviews, backlog refinement) as the business analysis representative for assigned initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and technical teams to prioritize and refine the product backlog.
  • Prepare clear, accurate documentation, including business requirement documents (BRDs), process maps, and status reporting for agency leadership.
  • Support user acceptance testing (UAT) by developing test scenarios tied to documented requirements and validating outcomes with stakeholders.

Required Technical Skills

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in business requirement within a psychiatric health facility or comparable behavioral health/clinical care setting.
  • Demonstrated experience working within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, including familiarity with SAFe ceremonies and artifacts.
  • Strong requirements elicitation, documentation, and process-mapping skills (e.g., BRDs, user stories, workflow diagrams).
  • Experience facilitating stakeholder workshops and translating clinical/operational needs into actionable technical requirements.
  • Proficiency with standard business analysis and collaboration tools (e.g., Microsoft Office/365, Visio, Jira, Confluence, or equivalent).

title: Legal Analyst
description:
• Resource will provide legal, communication, organizational, and decision-making support to the Client. Must be self-motivated and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines.
Perform a variety of legal support and decision-making duties including:

• Assisting in preparing responses to foreclosure actions, bankruptcy actions, and other process-oriented legal responses;
• Tracking status of foreclosure cases and Sheriff’s sales involving the client:
• Preparing a variety of legal documents necessary for the organization, such as contracts, mortgage releases/lien releases, reports, budgets, and internal communication;
• Sorting, analyzing and distributing mail within the legal department;
• Assisting Legal Counsel with word processing, filing and document transmittal services;
• Assisting Legal Counsel in transmitting legal correspondence to clients, customers, outside counsel and court officials by electronic filing, mail, fax or messenger;
• Managing special projects as assigned, including ensuring project progress, coordinating meetings, and maintaining organized project and case files;
• Assisting Legal Counsel in reviewing and making necessary data entry updates to Sharepoint contracts database;
• Performing records research, legal research, checking legal forms for accuracy, preparing legal documents, preparing drafts of contracts, preparing contract amendments; and
• Performing other tasks as needed and assigned.
Skills Required:

• Two (2) or four (4) year relevant educational degree (such as a Paralegal degree or certificate) Required 2 Years
• or minimum of 2 years exp in a law firm, government legal dept, corporate legal dept or equivalent setting w/exposure to legal terms and/or procedures Required 2 Years
• Minimum 2 years experience in the same position/employers Required 2 Years
• Demonstrated independent judgment and critical thinking skills Required 
• Exceptional organizational skills Required 
• Willingness and ability to take on a wide variety of tasks and new tasks as requested Required 
• Ability to work with sensitive documents and information w/o divulging information to internal or external parties Required 
• Interested in the mission of the Client and taking part in work that furthers that mission Required 
• Demonstrated effective verbal and superior written communication skills Required 
• Demonstrated customer service orientation Required 
• Able to think logically and analytically Required 
• Proactive in anticipating and alerting others to problems with projects or processes Required 
• Exceedingly high detail orientation and accuracy Required 
• Takes initiative and needs little supervision Required 
• Able to prioritize, organize tasks and time, and follow up without being prompted Required 
• Able to perform responsibilities efficiently, accurately and timely Required 
• Able to work well in a team environment and as part of a team Required 
• Possess a high level of expertise in Microsoft Word and proficient in basics of Microsoft Excel Required

title: Clinical Documentation Principal Trainer (Epic)
description:
• Clinical Documentation Principal Trainer responsible for developing and delivering EHR training, supporting providers, and optimizing documentation workflows. Partners with informatics and IT to improve efficiency, compliance, and patient care outcomes.

Training Development & Delivery (40%)

• Design, build, and maintain training curriculum for clinical documentation workflows (e.g., provider documentation, templates, SmartTools)
• Deliver instructor-led, virtual, and at-the-elbow training to providers and clinical staff
• Develop training materials including manuals, eLearning modules, quick reference guides, and simulations
• Ensure training content aligns with system updates, regulatory requirements, and organizational standards
EHR & Workflow Expertise (25%)

• Serve as a subject matter expert in clinical documentation workflows within the EHR (Epic preferred)
• Collaborate with application analysts and informatics teams to understand system design and changes
• Translate technical build into end-user training content
• Support go-live readiness activities and command center operations
Optimization & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Identify documentation improvement opportunities through feedback, metrics, and workflow analysis
• Partner with Clinical Informatics to support optimization initiatives and standardization efforts
• Update training materials and strategies based on system enhancements and user needs
• Promote best practices for accurate, efficient, and compliant documentation
Governance & Collaboration (10%)

• Participate in governance structures and workgroups related to clinical documentation
• Provide input on system design decisions impacting documentation workflows
• Ensure alignment with enterprise documentation standards and regulatory requirements
Support & Evaluation (5%)

• Evaluate training effectiveness through surveys, proficiency assessments, and performance metrics
• Provide ongoing support and coaching to end users
• Maintain training environment and related documentation
Skills Required:
• Epic-certified as Principal Trainer in Clinical Documentation	Required	5	Years
• Ability to work without close supervision, taking ownership of work activities, & ensuring training sessions & materials meet Epic's standards	Required		
• Experience with clinical documentation improvement (CDI) practices	Required	3	Years
• Familiarity with regulatory and compliance standards (e.g., Joint Commission, CMS)	Highly desired		
• Experience supporting large-scale EHR implementations or upgrades	Highly desired		
• Certified in developing the Epic training environments.	Highly desired	3	Years

title: Cybersecurity Engineer 3
description:
• The Cybersecurity Engineer develops and implements advanced cyber defense solutions for the agency, safeguards the infrastructure, and assures that the system is built to specification and is deployed successfully.
• The Client is seeking a highly analytical and technically proficient Cybersecurity Engineer supporting Splunk SIEM. You will play a critical role in defending our organization against cyber threats by leveraging Splunk Enterprise Security to monitor, detect, analyze, and respond to security events. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in log analysis, threat hunting, and writing Splunk queries to identify and contain malicious activity.

Key Responsibilities

• Threat Detection & Monitoring: Continuously monitor network traffic, endpoint logs, and cloud security events for anomalous behavior and potential security incidents.
• Splunk Management: Create, maintain, and tune Splunk correlation searches, alerts, and dashboards to minimize false positives and improve detection capabilities.
• Incident Response: Investigate potential security incidents, follow forensic evidence, and collaborate with IT and network teams to remediate threats.
• Use Case Development: Develop and refine detection and response playbooks based on threat intelligence and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.
• Log Integration: Work with infrastructure teams to onboard new data sources, ensuring log integrity, parsing, and normalization across the SIEM platform.
• Compliance & Reporting: Support audit readiness by collecting SIEM control evidence and generating compliance reports aligned with internal policies and standards

Skills Required:

• Minimum of 8+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, specifically operating, building, and investigating threats within a SIEM or Splunk.	Required	8	Years
• Excellent critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to operate calmly under pressure and manage multiple security tickets	Required	8	Years
• Proficiency in writing SPL (Splunk Processing Language)	Required	8	Years
• Strong understanding of networking, firewalls, EDR, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).	Required	8	Years
• Knowledge of security frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK) and security compliance standards (e.g., NIST, HIPAA, or SOC 2).	Required	8	Years
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field.	Required		
• Relevant certifications such as Splunk Core Certified User, Splunk Core Certified Advanced Power User, are highly preferred.	Highly desired	8	Years

  • Incident Response: Investigate potential security incidents, follow forensic evidence, and collaborate with IT and network teams to remediate threats.
  • Use Case Development: Develop and refine detection and response playbooks based on threat intelligence and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Log Integration: Work with infrastructure teams to onboard new data sources, ensuring log integrity, parsing, and normalization across the SIEM platform.
  • Compliance & Reporting: Support audit readiness by collecting SIEM control evidence and generating compliance reports aligned with internal policies and standards

Skills Required:

  • Minimum of 8+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, specifically operating, building, and investigating threats within a SIEM or Splunk. Required 8 Years
  • Excellent critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to operate calmly under pressure and manage multiple security tickets Required 8 Years
  • Proficiency in writing SPL (Splunk Processing Language) Required 8 Years
  • Strong understanding of networking, firewalls, EDR, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Required 8 Years
  • Knowledge of security frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK) and security compliance standards (e.g., NIST, HIPAA, or SOC 2). Required 8 Years
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field. Required
  • Relevant certifications such as Splunk Core Certified User, Splunk Core Certified Advanced Power User, are highly preferred. Highly desired 8 Years

title: Quality Assurance Analyst/Tester, Jr
description:
This posting is for a QA Analyst III. This position will support testing of modernization through supporting and leading the UAT test phase. This requested position should have knowledge and experience in manual and automation testing as part of an Agile/Scrum project team. The position also require experience in the use of the following tools: Jira, Zephyr for Jira, Sequel Server, Postman, Selenium, Tricentis Tosca, or other automation test tools. Current resources are assigned at maximum capacity testing modernized applications (EBMS, SEBT, and C-CARE), API and Performance Testing (EASL), learning new application functionality, learning Tricentis TOSCA, a new automation tool, as well as creating automation scripts for ServiceNow applications (Customer Portal, Provider Portal, Worker Portal, HR Portal, and Legal Portal) along with new modernization application C-CARE. Additional experienced staff is needed to meet customer expectations on modernization applications, to aid in working with users and the various business areas in creating and executing manual test cases. They also will be responsible for creating and executing automation test scripts to increase test coverage, better reuse repetitive tests to aid in reducing testing time, which will improve current employee tension and unforeseen turnovers.

title: Java Developer
description:
• The Client is seeking an experienced Java Developer Contractor to support the design, development, and maintenance of web applications, backend services, and cloud-based solutions. 
• This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working across the Java/Spring ecosystem, building REST APIs, integrating with AWS services, and contributing to modern CI/CD-driven development workflows.
• The right candidate will be hands-on, pragmatic, and comfortable working independently while collaborating with technical and business stakeholders.

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain Java-based applications using Java SDK 21.
• Build and enhance applications using Spring Boot and the broader Spring Framework.
• Develop and maintain REST APIs and JSON-based integrations.
• Support smaller web applications using Thymeleaf, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
• Work with AWS-based infrastructure and services, including ECS, API Gateway, and DynamoDB.
• Contribute to source control and development workflows using GitLab.
• Build, maintain, and troubleshoot GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
• Collaborate with team members on application architecture, implementation decisions, code reviews, and deployment practices.
• Support infrastructure-as-code efforts, especially where Terraform is used.
• Use IntelliJ IDEA as the primary development environment.
• Apply sound software engineering practices, including maintainable code design, testing, documentation, and operational awareness.
• Where appropriate, leverage AI-assisted coding tools to improve development productivity and code quality.

Required Qualifications

• Strong professional experience developing applications with Java.
• Experience with Java 21 or recent versions of the Java SDK.
• Solid experience with Spring Boot and Spring-based application development.
• Experience designing, building, and consuming REST APIs.
• Strong working knowledge of JSON and API integration patterns.
• Familiarity with front-end technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
• Experience using Git-based source control, preferably GitLab.
• Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitLab CI/CD.
• Practical experience developing, deploying, or supporting applications in AWS.
• Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and deliver high-quality work in a contractor capacity.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Thymeleaf for server-side templating.
• Hands-on experience with AWS services such as:
• Amazon ECS
• Amazon API Gateway
• Amazon DynamoDB
• Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
• Experience using IntelliJ IDEA in a professional development environment.
• Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar tools.
• Experience troubleshooting cloud deployments, application logs, build pipelines, and environment-related issues.
• Understanding of secure coding practices and cloud application security concepts.

Technical Environment

Our current technology stack includes:

• Java SDK 21
• Spring Boot / Spring Framework
• Thymeleaf
• REST APIs
• JSON
• HTML / CSS / JavaScript
• AWS, including ECS, API Gateway, and DynamoDB
• GitLab repositories
• GitLab CI/CD pipelines
• Terraform
• IntelliJ IDEA
• AI-assisted coding tools, including exploration of Claude Code

Ideal Candidate

• The ideal candidate is a strong Java developer who can move comfortably between backend development, lightweight front-end work, cloud-based deployments, and CI/CD workflows. 
• They should be able to understand existing systems quickly, contribute clean and maintainable code, and work effectively in a modern cloud-oriented development environment.
• Experience with AWS, GitLab pipelines, Terraform, and AI-assisted coding tools is highly valued.

title: Senior .NET Application & Accessibility Consultant(s)
description:
• Experienced Senior .NET Application & Accessibility Consultant having experience with AI tools to lead full-stack development and legacy code remediation and testing.
• In this role, the candidate will perform ADA scan to application code, plan and apply fixes to legacy .NET web applications ensuring strict adherence to WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and ADA Section 508 standards.
• The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in C#, modern JavaScript, Telerik and CSS with advanced knowledge of enterprise AI tooling (GitHub Enterprise Cloud Copilot, Claude AI) and modern DevOps pipelines. 
• The candidate will take ownership of the legacy PDF reports generated built on the Crystal Reports engine, convert those reports to ADA complaint/accessible PDF reports. 
• Additionally, auditing front-end interfaces, and executing systematic code remediation across complex C# / .NET applications.

Key Responsibilities

• Full-Stack .NET Development & Modernization: Develop, and maintain enterprise web applications built on modern C#, .NET, .NET Core, Telerik UI and standard HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript frontends.
• ADA Compliance & Web Accessibility (WCAG): Conduct comprehensive audits (using screen readers such as NVDA/WAVE alongside Claud.ai automated scans) and lead remediation efforts to ensure all web interfaces meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 Level AA and Section 508 requirements.
• Accessible PDF Generation: Conduct comprehensive audits of the legacy PDF reports code and build fully compliant, dynamic PDF reporting modules (tagged PDFs, reading orders, structural elements) directly within .NET workflows.
• AI-Assisted Engineering: Leverage enterprise AI tools—including GitHub Enterprise Cloud (GHEC) Copilot and Anthropic Claude—to accelerate code accessibility auditing, refactoring, documentation, and test generation.

Skill Required:

• .NET Core / .NET	Required	7	Years
• ASP.NET Core (MVC/Razor/Web API), and C# enterprise patterns	Required	8	Years
• Deep proficiency in native JavaScript (ES6+), modern CSS (Flexbox, Grid, CSS Variables, SCSS), and semantic HTML5	Required		
• Expert understanding of W3C web standards, cross-browser performance optimization, and responsive design patterns	Required		
• Expert-level knowledge of WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA guidelines, WAI-ARIA authoring practices, and ADA Section 508 compliance	Required		
• Hands-on experience developing accessible PDF output using .NET PDF libraries with proper tag trees, alternative text, reading order, and table header	Required		
• Experience testing with tools like Claude AI, NVDA, and WAVE	Required		
• Hands-on expertise using GitHub Enterprise Cloud (GHEC) Copilot and Anthropic Claude (Claude Code, API, or enterprise interfaces)	Required		
• Proven experience with CI/CD automation, pipeline configuration (GitHub Actions / Azure Pipelines), git workflows, and release engineering	Required

title: Service Support Analyst- Mid Level
description:
• The Budget Unit processes a high and growing volume of journal vouchers, contract authorizations, and budget revisions across state and federal funding sources.

Key Responsibilities

•  Prepare, review, and process journal vouchers so that expenditures and corrections are recorded accurately across the appropriate funding sources.
•  Monitor contract spend against authorized budgets and produce regular reports on contract utilization, variances, and projected spend.
•  Track fund utilization across state and federal sources and confirm that spending remains aligned with appropriated and certified amounts.
•  Prepare and process budget revisions to the appropriation and certified budget, with clear documentation and an audit trail for each revision.
•  Support reconciliation and respond to questions from program and finance staff on contract and budget matters

Skills Required:

•  Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage a high volume of transactions accurately.
•  Proficiency with spreadsheets and financial systems, with the ability to produce clear reports for leadership.
•  Ability to work independently and meet recurring deadlines.
• Experience in budget analysis, accounting, or financial reporting, preferably in a government or healthcare finance setting.	Required	3	Years
• Experience executing against multiple priorities/projects.	Required	3	Years
• Proficient use of project collaboration and tracking tools (Microsoft Project Suite, MS Teams, Zoom, etc.)	Required	3	Years
• Exceptional written and oral communication skills.	Required	3	Years
• Experience monitoring Contract Spend on multiple Contracts	Required	3	Years
• Prior state government/public sector experience with health and human services programs (such as Medicaid, Medicaid Management Information System (MMI	Highly desired	3	Years
• Experience with tracking fund utilization across state and federal sources	Required	3	Years

title: Managed Care Specialist
description:
Key Responsibilities

• Determine individual and family eligibility for our Client’s care programs.
• Assist in coordinating and communicating schedules to internal/external Clients.Conduct client interviews, collect facts and information, and compile case data to provide recommendations to an attorney.
• Timely management of casework, including proper documentation and case resolution.
• Provide legal research, analysis of legal papers, and draft legal documents. Document findings accurately.
• Work efficiently / effectively in multiple databases to extract information.
• Attend workgroup meetings and participate in discussions.
• Assist leadership team, as necessary. 
Requirements and Skills

• Must have a bachelor’s or associate degree.
• A background in Paralegal studies is a plus.
• Work experience in a Legal environment a plus.
• Customer service or call center experience a plus.
• Proven technical skills (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.).
• Excellent time management skills with the ability to prioritize work to meet specific deadlines with minimal supervision.
• Excellent verbal and written communications skills.
• Keen attention to detail and adherence to deadlines.
• Strong time management, note-taking, email organization, and distribution skills.
• Critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Other Important Information

• The position is a hybrid position in downtown Nashville, TN. The contractor will work onsite and remotely based on the team’s schedule.
• The position is contract for 12 months with an opportunity to be extended.

title: Communications Specialist -2nd Shift
description:
• The Client provide 24/7 services to its citizens. The PM Network Operational Monitoring position will provide first line network technical support to employees and business partners by calling the Enterprise Network Operation Monitoring Network Service Desk outside of regular business hours. 

• This position requires a technical individual with a customer-service-minded approach to dealing with staff and IT teams. The individual will work closely with staff, vendors, service providers and IT staff, but must also be able to work independently, multitask by prioritizing and managing their own workload, and able to ensure prompt service and end-user issue resolution.

• The NOC Communications Specialist provides after-hour and weekend hours Level 1 Support by performing the skills listed below.

Role Description:

End-user Support

• Answer inbound phone calls concerning network issues from employees, and LEC/Last User Contract, LUC, vendors.

• Creates and escalates Service Now trouble tickets to Engineers, tier two staff, and/or third-party service providers to ensure the quick resolution of IT/Network issues.

• Works with NOC T2 Engineers,  staff and contracted personnel, and/or third-party providers as needed.

• Research and updates reference publications and diagnostic aids to seek information necessary to resolve end-user issues as needed.

• Follows IT Service Desk and Network Operator Knowledgebase procedures and makes recommendations when improvements are needed.

• Promptly and properly escalate high priority issues.

Monitoring & Maintenance

• Utilize network management tools, such as Solar Winds and Squared up, to monitor remote sites network and hardware.

· Actively monitors the status of  networks and attached network assets using established tools and promptly initiates appropriate actions.

• Responds to outages and system failures using established escalation processes.

• Provide first-line investigation and diagnosis of network incidents, logging all details and prioritization of incidents.

• Escalate after hours incidents to staff for resolution.

• Promptly assign unresolved incidents to higher Tier support or LUC providers to coordinate restoration of service and obtain the necessary information for recording/tracking the outage or degradation of service.

• Coordinate with network staff and various vendors to assist with service restoration based on alarm conditions.

• Actively monitors the Service Now ticket queue.

• Monitors appropriate  email accounts for any event messages and initiates action as needed.

• Proactively identifies and resolves problems.

Communication

• Acts as the primary network contact for employees and business partners outside of regular business hours.

• Perform Enterprise Incident communications using defined process and approved template.

• Monitors the network hotline during coverage hours.

• Issues network status updates using established procedures.

• Follows quality standards and displays strong customer service skills.

Routine Tasks

• Assists the network engineers and technicians with outstanding tasks.

• Updates network operation and knowledgebase documentation.

• Participates in disaster recovery.

• Completes assigned tasks.

Required Skills:

• Possesses excellent communication skills; both written and spoken.

• Ability to be clearly understood and has excellent phone etiquette.

• Ability to support end-users with varying IT skillsets.

• Ability to follow directions, especially when using established operation and knowledgebase documentation, and standard operating procedures.

• Ability to adapt to change.

• Detail oriented and resourceful.

• Excellent organizational skills.

• Ability to troubleshoot end-user issues and/or escalate as needed to ensure quick resolution.

• Experience with incident management, call tracking, and ticketing software.

• Preferred 2+ years previous systems administrator, help desk, and/or call center experience.

  • This position requires a technical individual with a customer-service-minded approach to dealing with staff and IT teams. The individual will work closely with staff, vendors, service providers and IT staff, but must also be able to work independently, multitask by prioritizing and managing their own workload, and able to ensure prompt service and end-user issue resolution.
  • The NOC Communications Specialist provides after-hour and weekend hours Level 1 Support by performing the skills listed below.

Role Description:

End-user Support

  •  Answer inbound phone calls concerning network issues from employees, and LEC/Last User Contract, LUC, vendors.
  •  Creates and escalates Service Now trouble tickets to Engineers, tier two staff, and/or third-party service providers to ensure the quick resolution of IT/Network issues.
  •  Works with NOC T2 Engineers, staff and contracted personnel, and/or third-party providers as needed.
  •  Research and updates reference publications and diagnostic aids to seek information necessary to resolve end-user issues as needed.
  •  Follows IT Service Desk and Network Operator Knowledgebase procedures and makes recommendations when improvements are needed.
  •  Promptly and properly escalate high priority issues.

Monitoring & Maintenance

  •  Utilize network management tools, such as Solar Winds and Squared up, to monitor remote sites network and hardware.
  •  Actively monitors the status of networks and attached network assets using established tools and promptly initiates appropriate actions.
  •  Responds to outages and system failures using established escalation processes.
  •  Provide first-line investigation and diagnosis of network incidents, logging all details and prioritization of incidents.
  •  Escalate after hours incidents to staff for resolution.
  •  Promptly assign unresolved incidents to higher Tier support or LUC providers to coordinate restoration of service and obtain the necessary information for recording/tracking the outage or degradation of service.
  •  Coordinate with network staff and various vendors to assist with service restoration based on alarm conditions.
  • Actively monitors the Service Now ticket queue.
  • Monitors appropriate email accounts for any event messages and initiates action as needed.
  • Proactively identifies and resolves problems.

Communication

  •  Acts as the primary network contact for employees and business partners outside of regular business hours.
  •  Perform Enterprise Incident communications using defined process and approved template.
  •  Monitors the network hotline during coverage hours.
  •  Issues network status updates using established procedures.
  •  Follows quality standards and displays strong customer service skills.

Routine Tasks

  •  Assists the network engineers and technicians with outstanding tasks.
  •  Updates network operation and knowledgebase documentation.
  •  Participates in disaster recovery.
  •  Completes assigned tasks.

Required Skills:

  •  Possesses excellent communication skills; both written and spoken.
  •  Ability to be clearly understood and has excellent phone etiquette.
  •  Ability to support end-users with varying IT skillsets.
  •  Ability to follow directions, especially when using established operation and knowledgebase documentation, and standard operating procedures.
  •  Ability to adapt to change.
  •  Detail oriented and resourceful.
  •  Excellent organizational skills.
  •  Ability to troubleshoot end-user issues and/or escalate as needed to ensure quick resolution.
  •  Experience with incident management, call tracking, and ticketing software.
  •  Preferred 2+ years previous systems administrator, help desk, and/or call center experience.

title: Salesforce Solutions Expert
description:
Client  requires Salesforce Solutions Expert/Architect to lead DCDEE Early Education Integration System to design and delivery of secure,scalable and user-focused Salesforce and integration solution that align with the organization’s digital strategy.

Client is seeking an experienced Salesforce Solution Expert/Architect for leading DCDEE's prestigious project Early Education Integration System at in-house to design and delivery of secure, scalable and user-focused Salesforce and integration solutions that align with the organization’s digital strategy. In this role, This role will bridge strategic business needs with robust and secure solution architecture, collaborating with stakeholders, developers and technical leads to deliver cutting edge and sustainable enterprise solutions. This role will be in a crucial role in shaping the future of our Salesforce ecosystem, leading architectural designs and defining complex integrations between systems. This role will also be a hands-on technical expert having cross-functional leadership and a passion for continuous innovation. Responsibilities include Architect end-to-end solutions and guiding technical strategies and execution, Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts, Tech lead and business stakeholders to transform business scope into accurate and cost-effective technical architecture, Design and lead implementation of complex API based integration solutions, connecting Salesforce application with sophisticated external Systems, Ensure every solution aligns with data security and performance standards, Design appropriate backups and restore strategies. Identify and mitigate technical risks across the architecture, Describe best practices and justification for when to use standard Salesforce functionality when solutioning complex requirements and when customizations are a better fit, Create high-quality technical documentation, data modelling and solution diagrams, Leading code reviews, design sessions/workshops and release planning sessions, Collaborating with Agile team in backlog refinement, user story decomposition and acceptance criteria refinement, Assist in Salesforce environment set up and CI/CD pipeline process using appropriate release management tool and Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth project integration and delivery.

Required / Desired Skills

• Salesforce Technical Architect/Application Architect certification - Required
• Salesforce Integration Architect certification  - Required 
• Salesforce Platform Developer II Certification  - Required
• Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder Certification  - Required
• Copado certification  - Required
• MuleSoft I and II certifications  - Required
• Experience with requirements analysis and business process design. - Required 7 Years
• Experience in architecting and developing complex solutions in Salesforce platform.  - Required 7 Years
• Extensive experience in Apex, LWC, Aura, Flows, SOSL, SOQL, Salesforce Admin and advanced architectural patterns, unit testing and best test practices  - Required 7 Years
• Strong understanding and experience with all configuration aspects of Salesforce including development  - Required 7 Years
• Experience in guiding development team on appropriate use of platform technology  - Required 7 Years
• Experience with object-oriented design patterns and languages such as Apex, Java, JavaScript, C#, and Ruby.  - Required 7 Years
• Experience in data migration strategies and common extract, transform, load (ETL) tools  - Required 7 Years
• Experience in general mobile solutions and architecture and understanding of on-platform mobile solutions and considerations  - Required 7 Years
• Experience using Shield and Lightning  - Required 7 Years
• Experience with Salesforce DevOps and CI/CD pipelines  - Required 5 Years
• Experience in accessibility laws and WCAG 2.1 compliance  - Required 5 Years
• Experience with GITHUB/BitBucket version control solutions  - Required 5 Years
• Experience with Agile Methodologies  - Required 5 Years

title: Project Manager – Sr Level
description:
• The position supports the Client as the Procurement Project Manager for the entire agency.  The position will serve as the technical liaison between Client and the Central Procurement Office (CPO) assisting in the development of proposals for bids while maintaining the interests of the  Procurement policies and procedures. This position will administer procurement activities from development and implementation of the sourcing strategy through award of the contract, which includes identifying agency needs, drafting solicitations, aid CPO in executing procurements and aid CPO in the evaluation. The position requires strong organizational skills and the ability to work with multiple schedules. This position requires excellent project and time management capabilities.

Responsibilities

• Develops and assists divisions in solicitation specifications based on internal and external sources of information
• Possesses and demonstrates strong knowledge of policies, procedures and execution strategy for multiple solicitation methods including Request for Proposal, Request for Qualification, and Request for Information.
• Regularly represents the client and the division of Grants and Contracts while speaking with internal and external stakeholders
• Provides strategic advice and consultation to agency procurement and program staff to determine the proper methods of procurement as well as strategy development and execution of procurement activities

Qualifications

• Graduation from an accredited college or university with a bachelor’s degree and 5 to 10 years of business, procurement, and/or contract management experience

title: Clerical Assistant
skills: Complete filing on a regular basis
description:
• Provides assistance and support to the District field office personnel and to individuals interacting with the Bureau (consumers, families, providers of services and other community agencies.)
• The Clerical Assistant is often the first person in the office with whom an individual visiting or calling has contact.  The position also ensures that the office is running smoothly and efficiently by completing such duties as:  maintaining supply inventory, answering telephones and greeting guests, scheduling assessments, maintaining records of consumer assessments, filing, faxing, and ensuring the timely submission of attendance forms and mileage vouchers.

1. Telephone and reception:

• Provide assistance to walk-in clients and provide general information and accessibility to new applications and other requested documentation as needed.
• Operate the central telephone system
• Answer calls and direct to the appropriate person
• Manage the voicemail system during the day and set up the after-hours system
• Greet and direct guests in the office
• Answer callers basic questions
• Assist callers with the use of the online BDDS Waiting List portal

2. Office equipment:

•  Operate all office equipment (copier, printer,fax, computer, postage machine, etc.)
•  Daily maintenance of machines (refill paper, change toner, etc.)
•  Troubleshoot minor problems or arrange for repairs when needed
•  Maintain the official office equipment inventory

3. Appeals co-oridination

• gather documents for BDS appeal hearings
• Navigate BDS databases to locate needed documents
• Respond to requests for documentation in a timely manner.

4. Mail:

•  Mail application packets to consumers/families within one business day of receiving client information.
•  Open, date stamp, and distribute incoming mail
•  Process postage and deliver outgoing mail to the mailbox
• Handle special delivery requirements such as certified, overnight etc

5. Administrative activities:

•  Assist with general office tasks including ensuring new staff are able to access electronic calendars, scanners,copiers, and faxes as well as assisting with setting up voicemail and mailboxes.
•  Perform administrative tasks as otherwise assigned on an as needed basis
•  Process all new incoming applications, document on the application tracking log, and ensure proper filing and uploading of all incoming documentation within one day of receiving application.
•  Document all intakes on the intake tracking log, process and upload files accordingly into the online database, and file records per record retention policies. Secretary will also enter new applications into DART per each individual’s file.

6. Files:

• Complete filing on a regular basis
• Purge files as needed
•  Archive files according to the established process
