title: Business Analyst 3
description:
• This position provides business analysis and project coordination support for Pharmacy project and also for VASE+ and several .net maintenance applications. 
• The Client is seeking two Business Analysts to support enterprise-wide web application initiatives and Pharmacy Partner Hub programs. These roles require close collaboration with business stakeholders, technical teams, and federal/state partners to ensure business processes, requirements, enhancements, and new initiatives are thoroughly analyzed and documented for successful IT implementation. Analysts will participate in Agile ceremonies, testing efforts, cross-functional troubleshooting, and creation of customer-facing and technical documentation.

Responsibilities

• Gather and document business requirements for new initiatives, system enhancements, and application needs.
• Document current and future state processes, GAP analyses, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
• Facilitate Agile ceremonies: daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives.
• Conduct project meetings, demos, trainings, and prepare detailed meeting notes.
• Present requirements to technical and business teams for validation and discussion.
• Participate in functional and systems integration testing; develop test plans, scenarios, and results.
• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and customer validation.
• Develop user guides, training materials, and provide implementation/maintenance support.
• Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and support teams to resolve cross-functional issues.
• Utilize tools including MS Office, SharePoint, Teams, GitLab, MS Project, and Visio.
• Support project managers in RFP/SOW reviews and Agile tool management.

Required Skills & Experience

• 5+ years of business analysis experience, including requirements gathering and documentation.
• Strong analytical, problem solving, organizational, and communication skills.
• Experience with process mapping, feasibility studies, system documentation, and customer engagement.
• Knowledge of SDLC and multiple project management methodologies (Waterfall, Iterative, Agile).
• Ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities independently.
• Strong SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle databases experience (5 years).
• Web application experience with Oracle APEX, Microsoft .NET.
• Bachelor's degree in IT, Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Skills

• Healthcare information systems experience.
• Familiarity with Commonwealth of Virginia SEC 501.
• Experience with RFP development, .NET applications, and system upgrades/interface design.

title: Infrastructure Solutions Architect 3
description:
• The FAS Solution Architect serves as a technical lead responsible for overseeing, governing, and guiding a new Fiscal Agent Services (FAS) technology solution that supports the Medicaid enterprise system and its business operations. This role works closely with business stakeholders, program leadership, vendors, and technical teams to ensure solutions align with Medicaid Program goals, federal and state regulations, enterprise architecture standards, and modernization initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

• Oversee and guide technical implementation of anew Fiscal Agent Services module, as part of the Medicaid Enterprise System(MES) system
• Ensure solutions align with CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) guidelines, MITA maturity goals, interoperability standards, and federal modularity requirements.
• Lead architectural reviews, assess solution implementation, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and technical policies.
• Evaluate system integration needs across modules such as Eligibility and Enrollment, Provider Services, Third-Party Liability, Pharmacy, and Data Warehousing.

title: Application Developer
description:
• The Client is seeking a skilled Power BI Developer to assist with our BI Program. Ideally will have expertise in the following technical areas aspects:
• Requirements Gathering

Collaborates with the business and with data analysts to understand requirements and business objectives for relevant reports & visualizations as well as underlying data model. 

Capable of identifying relevant data sources and attributes for use in model

Proficient in using Excel at an intermediate level, comfortable with complex formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis. 

Ability to reverse engineer processes originally developed by business users, deconstructing existing formulas, pivot tables, and data analyses to interpret business requirements based on existing manual processes and suggest efficiency improvements and logic optimizations.

• Data Modeling:

Designing and documenting efficient conceptual, logical, and physical data models to support business requirements. 

Understands how to deliver row and column-level security within the Power BI semantic model.

Needs to be able to establish re-usable semantic data models within Power BI.  

Familiarity with running tabular Editor Best Practice Analyzer for adhering to modeling and DAX best practices.

Creating relationships between tables and optimizing data structures.

• Data Source Connectivity Setup:

Connecting to various data sources (APIs, Big Query, ArcGIS map and feature layers, SQL databases, Excel files,  etc.) including streaming datasets.

Ensuring seamless data extraction and transformation.

Collaborating with the members of OIT Integrations team to ascertain available integration patterns. 

• DAX Formulas:

Proficiency in writing DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) formulas.

Calculated columns, measures, and custom calculations.

• Report Creation:

Designing and developing interactive and visually appealing reports and dashboards.

Incorporating slicers, visuals, and drill-through functionality, including streaming and ArcGIS visuals.

Capable of optimizing Power BI reports or making suggestions to underlying data model for performance, including the use of DAX Studio and built in Power BI performance tools.

• Power BI Service & Deployment:

Proficient in publishing reports to the Power BI Service, managing access controls, automating refresh schedules, and optimizing report performance for large datasets.

• AI Familiarity:

Comfortable working with AI tools and leveraging AI technologies to enhance processes and optimize data analysis workflows. Experience with Google AI tools is a plus.

It is expected that the developer will follow organizational patterns for source and version control for Power BI files and be able to utilize Azure DevOps as appropriate within that process. 

• Collaboration & Communication Skills:

Experienced in collaborating with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, explain technical concepts to non-technical users, and deliver reports that align with business goals.

Ability to present complex data insights and reports to non-technical audiences and stakeholders, ensuring clarity and effective communication.

Experienced in meeting preparation, screensharing and conducting working sessions which may include discussing backlog item statuses, and gathering additional requirements as they may change.

title: Lead / Manager, Full Stack Development – Cloud & IoT Platforms
description:
About Job RoleWe are seeking a hands-on Full Stack Development Lead/Manager, with 10-15 years of software engineering experience to lead and contribute directly to the architecture, development, deployment, and lifecycle support of scalable cloud-connected applications. This is a player-coach role: the successful candidate will lead a team of engineers while remaining technically hands-on across backend services, web applications, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, real-time data pipelines, and production troubleshooting.

The role will be central to building highly available digital platforms for remote supervision, configuration, health monitoring, control, telemetry, and event-driven alerting across connected field devices and gateways. Solutions must support secure, low-latency interaction between cloud applications and IoT / edge systems used in fire, life-safety, paging, and emergency communication environments, where reliability, traceability, resilience, and security are critical.

Key Responsibilities
Engineering Leadership & Delivery• Lead, mentor, and develop a full stack engineering team, setting clear technical direction, coding standards, and delivery expectations while remaining a strong individual contributor.

• Own assigned software programs from requirements and architecture through implementation, verification, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement.

• Plan technical work, identify dependencies and risks, drive design and code reviews, and ensure timely closure of architecture, quality, security, and performance issues.

• Build engineering redundancy by documenting architecture, critical workflows, deployment practices, troubleshooting playbooks, and technical decisions.

Full Stack Architecture & Development• Architect and develop scalable backend services primarily using Python and Golang, with well-defined RESTful APIs and microservices boundaries.

• Develop and guide React.js web applications with effective component architecture and state management using modern React patterns such as Hooks and Redux where appropriate.

• Design robust data models, database schemas, indexes, and queries in PostgreSQL; diagnose and resolve database performance, concurrency, and data-integrity issues.

• Apply secure authentication and authorization patterns, including OAuth / JWT, role-based access control, secrets management, and service-to-service security.

Connected Devices, Real-Time Data & IoT Integration• Design application flows for connected field devices, edge gateways, and cloud services, including device discovery, provisioning, configuration, heartbeat / health monitoring, telemetry, command-and-control, and event handling.

• Implement and support real-time and event-driven communication using MQTT, REST APIs, Kafka, WebSockets and, where applicable, SIP / WebRTC or related communication technologies.

• Engineer reliable message handling for intermittent networks and field conditions, including reconnect behaviour, retries, idempotency, duplicate handling, buffering, and fault recovery.

• Collaborate with embedded, hardware, test, and product teams to integrate device protocols, APIs, telemetry streams, and alarms into unified web and cloud applications.

Cloud, Containers & Data Platforms• Design and deploy applications on AWS using services such as EC2, S3, RDS and other appropriate managed services, with attention to scalability, availability, security, and cost.

• Containerize services using Docker and contribute to cloud-native deployment patterns, release automation, and environment management.

• Establish and improve CI/CD pipelines, automated build/test/deploy practices, configuration management, and controlled production releases.

• Design and operate streaming and asynchronous pipelines using Apache Kafka and related messaging technologies; exposure to Hadoop / large-scale data processing is advantageous.

Reliability, Security, Quality & Production Support• Build applications for high availability and fault tolerance, including health checks, graceful degradation, failover, retry strategies, and production recovery mechanisms.

• Implement effective logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing, alerting, and troubleshooting practices to shorten incident detection and root-cause resolution time.

• Own complex cross-stack debugging from browser / UI through API, service, database, message pipeline, cloud infrastructure, and connected-device layers.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership• Partner with US Engineering, Product Management, UX, DevOps, SDET, embedded / firmware, hardware, manufacturing, and other stakeholders.

• Communicate architecture, risks, technical trade-offs, incidents, and delivery status clearly to engineering leadership and cross-functional teams.

Key Success Measures• Predictable delivery of secure, production-ready full stack capabilities against committed scope, quality, schedule, and performance expectations.

• High availability and reliable operation of cloud-connected applications and real-time device data flows, with effective diagnostics and rapid recovery from failures.

• Strong hands-on contribution in Python / Go backend services, React applications, PostgreSQL, APIs, cloud deployment, and production troubleshooting.

• Improved engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, security practices, observability, reusable architecture patterns, and clear documentation.

Qualifications• 10–15 years of software development experience with substantial full stack, backend, cloud, and distributed-systems responsibility;

• Prior experience leading a team of 4-5 engineers is strongly preferred.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related engineering discipline; MTech / MCA or equivalent advanced qualification is an advantage.

• Demonstrated player-coach capability: able to lead architecture and people while remaining hands-on in coding, design reviews, debugging, and production problem solving.

• Strong experience developing scalable, secure, production-grade applications and services, preferably for connected products, industrial systems, IoT, real-time monitoring.

• Strong communication, analytical reasoning, ownership, collaboration, and technical decision-making skills.

Tech Stack & Tools• Python backend development

• Golang for microservices / performance-sensitive services

• React.js

• RESTful API design and implementation

• Microservices architecture

• Database schema design and query optimization

• AWS (including EC2, S3, RDS)

• Docker / containerization

• Security: authentication / authorization using OAuth, JWT, RBAC or equivalent patterns

• PostgreSQL

• CI/CD and DevOps practices

• Apache Kafka / real-time pipelines

Core CompetenciesOwnership & Accountability | Full Stack Engineering | Cloud & Distributed Systems | Real-Time IoT Integration | Systems Thinking | Hands-on Technical Leadership | Security & Reliability | Problem Solving | Cross-Functional Collaboration | Production Support Excellence | Continuous Improvement

title: Public Health Program Director 1
description:
• The Client is seeking a full-time contract Public Health Program Director 1. The Parents as Teachers (PAT) Evidence-Based Home Visiting (EBHV) Model Consultant provides quality assurance, technical assistance, and contract monitoring to local PAT programs funded by the Client. This position helps ensure that grantees meet contractual, programmatic, and model-specific requirements while delivering high-quality, visiting (EBHV) services to pregnant women and families with young children.
• The PAT Model Consultant supports local programs in strengthening implementation, addressing challenges, and maintaining alignment with client expectations and PAT model requirements. As an integral member of the state Early Childhood Initiatives (ECI) team, this position contributes to the oversight, coordination, and continuous improvement of prevention-focused EBHV services across Tennessee.
Duties and Responsibilities:

• Support the development and ongoing operation of Tennessee’s Parents as Teachers state office designation by coordinating statewide leadership, affiliate support, model replication, training, technical assistance, quality improvement, and collaboration with Parents as Teachers National Center.
• Provide consultation and technical assistance to local grantees implementing the Parents as Teachers model.
• Develop and revise contract language for local implementing agencies in alignment with program, model, and requirements.
• Conduct quality assurance and technical assistance visits for client funded Parents as Teachers programs to assess model implementation, support program improvement, and address identified needs.
• Host a model-specific meeting and/or Community of Practice.
• Collaborate with  program staff to align Parents as Teachers policies, procedures, referral processes, and services with Tennessee’s broader Early Childhood and EBHV Systems.
• Collaborate with key ECI staff, including Epidemiologist and CQI Director, to evaluate program measures, assess the effectiveness of interventions, and support Continuous Quality Improvement efforts.
• Assist with grant development and writing, conference planning, and other  activities as identified by the manager.
• Serves as the primary contact with the Parents as Teachers national office.
• Participate in national and state advisory groups, committees, and work groups as requested or invited.
• Establish and maintain positive, credible, and professional relationships with all state and local partners and always represent the best interests of Client.
• Participate in section, division, and level activities that strengthen knowledge and understanding of health equity, health disparities, and related public health practices.
• Maintain an understanding of current sections, divisions, and initiatives designed to reduce health disparities and promote diversity in the workforce.
• Promote the meaningful inclusion of parent and family voice in state and local grantee activities.
Qualifications/Requirements: 

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in early childhood, home visiting, or family support fields. Masters preferred. 
Experience: 

• Professional experience in maternal and/or child health, with at least two years of prevention-focused home visiting, preferred.
• Experience providing leadership to other professionals via consultation, training, supervision, or administration is preferred.
Desired Skills and Characteristics:

• Experience with program monitoring, consultation, planning, development, implementation, and evaluation; knowledge of prevention-focused home visiting programs serving pregnant women and families with young children; ability to collaborate effectively with individuals and groups; ability to provide leadership and guidance to home visiting professionals; ability to gather stakeholder feedback, identify training needs, coordinate access to training opportunities, and plan and facilitate meetings.
Impact on Projects, Services, and Operations

• This position will have a direct impact on the implementation of the EBHV program, Parents As Teachers, ultimately improving outcomes for families with high-risk. This position will work as part of the ECI team to support building the statewide EBHV system.

title: Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Program Director
description:
• The Client is seeking a Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Program Director to provide leadership and strategic direction for all end-to-end revenue cycle operations across facilities, including patient access, health information management, coding, billing, accounts receivable, payer management, and collections. 
• This role drives strategy to optimize financial performance, ensure regulatory compliance, minimize denials, and improve cash flow while guiding a multi-tiered team of managers and staff. 
• The Director partners with senior leadership, state agencies, and payer organizations to align operations with financial goals, oversees key metrics and reporting, manages complex Medicaid/Medicare billing requirements, ensures audit readiness, and guides technology optimization within Epic and related systems to continuously improve efficiency and accountability.

Skills set:

• Knowledge of full healthcare revenue cycle operations (patient access, HIM/coding, billing, A/R, denials).
• Understanding of Medicaid, Medicaid Managed Care, Medicare, and commercial payer reimbursement.
• Experience leading enterprise revenue cycle teams with managers and specialized staff.
• Ability to develop and execute revenue cycle strategy aligned with financial and compliance objectives.
• Expertise managing KPIs such as A/R days, denial rate, clean claims, and net collections.
• Strong knowledge of CMS, HIPAA, state regulations, and payer policies.
• Skill in maintaining internal controls, audit readiness, and compliance frameworks.
• Proficiency with Epic revenue cycle systems (Prelude, Cadence, Resolute HB/PB) and workflow governance.
• Ability to lead technology optimization, analytics, automation, and reporting.
• Strong partnership and collaboration skills across finance, clinical operations, IT, compliance, and payer organizations.
• Executive communication ability to present complex financial, operational, and regulatory information.
• Financial acumen to evaluate trends, forecast cash, assess reimbursement risks, and drive improvements.
• Competence in leading organizational change, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Understanding of revenue cycle considerations for behavioral health, psychiatric care, developmental disabilities, and operated facilities.

title: Administrative Support Specialist
description:
Position Summary                 

The IAP Support Specialist serves as a resource to ensure operational excellence for the Tennessee Department of Health Ryan White Part B (RWPB) AIDS Drug Assistance Program (ADAP), which is comprised of the Insurance Assistance Program (IAP) and the HIV Drug Assistance Program (HDAP). HDAP is managed internally by the Tennessee Department of Health (TDH), while IAP is administered through a third-party vendor.

The overarching goal of this position is to improve the health and well-being of low-income Tennesseans living with HIV by ensuring year-round, uninterrupted access to HIV medications for all program enrollees. The IAP Support Specialist serves as a critical liaison among Ryan White field case managers, TDH partners, healthcare providers, and program vendors to facilitate enrollment, resolve issues, improve communications, and support efficient program operations.

This position provides real-time technical assistance and customer support related to IAP enrollment and participation, while helping identify trends, resolve complex cases, and promote consistency across statewide program operations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Program Support and Enrollment Assistance

• Serve as the primary point of contact for Ryan White field case managers seeking real-time assistance with Insurance Assistance Program (IAP) enrollment, eligibility, renewals, and participation.
• Provide guidance regarding program policies, procedures, documentation requirements, and enrollment processes.
• Assist with troubleshooting enrollment barriers and resolving issues that may impact clients’ access to insurance coverage and HIV medications.
• Ensure accurate and timely communication regarding program updates, enrollment requirements, and procedural changes.
 Client and Case Management Support

• Collaborate with medical case managers throughout Tennessee to identify and resolve ADAP issues affecting HIV/AIDS clients.
• Support efforts to remove barriers to care and medication access for eligible clients.
• Research and resolve client-specific concerns while ensuring compliance with program guidelines and confidentiality requirements.
• Promote a client-centered approach focused on continuity of care and access to treatment.
 Partner Collaboration and Issue Resolution

• Work closely with Tennessee Department of Health partners, vendors, and manager to resolve complex operational and client-related issues.
• Escalate and coordinate resolution of cases requiring multi-agency or cross-functional involvement.
• Assist in identifying systematic issues, recurring challenges, and emerging trends affecting program operations or client outcomes.
• Provide feedback and recommendations for process improvements that enhance program efficiency and effectiveness.
 Communication and Customer Service

1. Manage a high volume of incoming and outgoing telephone calls and electronic communications.

2. Maintain efficient, streamlined, and uniform communication with field case managers, TDH staff, healthcare providers, and program partners.

3. Provide professional, responsive, and solution-focused customer service.

4. Document interactions, resolutions, and follow-up activities in accordance with established procedures.

 Operational Excellence and Quality Improvement

• Monitor workflows and support efforts to maintain operational excellence across the ADAP program.
• Assist with quality assurance activities, data validation, and program monitoring initiatives.
• Identify opportunities to improve processes, communication, and service delivery.
• Participate in meetings, training, and collaborative workgroups to support program goals and continuous improvement efforts.

 Minimum Required Qualifications

*Eligibility to work in the United States

• Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Health Administration, Public Health, Healthcare Management, or a closely related field.
• Minimum of four (4) years of front-facing customer services experience, preferably in healthcare, public health, health insurance, or health administration setting.
• Experience working in a health administration environment with demonstrated knowledge of healthcare operations, processes, and client service delivery.
• Proven ability to thoroughly document client interactions, research issues, conduct appropriate follow-up, and bring issues to resolution in a timely manner.
• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex situations, identify solutions, and coordinate resolution among multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Ability to work effectively in a moderately-paced environment while managing multiple tasks and maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly to changing procedures, priorities, and program requirements.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with case managers, healthcare professionals, Tennessee Dept of Health staff, vendors, and community partners.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and experience working with databases, case management systems, or other electronic information systems, simultaneously.
• Ability to maintain confidentiality and comply with all the applicable HIPAA, Ryan White Program, and organizational requirements.

 Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting Ryan White HIV/AIDS Program services, AIDS Drug Assistance Programs (ADAP), health insurance enrollment, or benefits coordination.
• Knowledge of HIV care systems, medication access programs, and healthcare coverage options.
• Experience providing technical assistance and support to case managers, healthcare providers, or public health partners.
• Experience working with state or federally funded healthcare programs.

description:

• The Internal Affairs Specialist will assist the  Internal Affairs Director and Investigator with enforcing the agency’s program for detecting and deterring employee misconduct, policy violations, fraud, waste, and abuse of state resources and assets, and other improprieties within the agency. 

The responsibilities of this position will include, but may not be limited to:

• Preparing and submitting Outlook data log requests.
• Preparing and submitting case management system data log requests
• Analyzing and converting data log reports into clear, sequential narrative summaries
• Scheduling investigation-related interviews
• Assisting with note-taking during interviews
• Assisting with maintaining the Internal Affairs Referral investigation portal and electronic investigation file system
• Compiling evidentiary materials for investigations
• Proofreading and editing investigation report documents
• Assisting other Ethics and Compliance Division department as needed
• Strong written and verbal communication skills; solid organizational skills; exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills; clear understanding of the concepts of ethics, integrity, and confidentiality; ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, follow directions, and exercise sound judgment in decision making
• Performance success is measured against the goal of maximizing Departmental efficiency and quality.

• Department procedures. Problems will be discussed with the Internal Affairs Director, Internal Affairs

title: Data Collection Admin Staff
description:
• Data Collection Admin Staff: The data collection staff will assist the client in its statutory responsibilities related to sex and violent offender registration.

Duties:

• The data collection staff will assist in its statutory responsibilities related to sex and violent offender registration. Incumbent reports to the Sex and Violent Offender Registration and Victim Services 

Essential Functions:

• Research and collect court documents
• Analyze and interpret the documents collected
• Communicate with local and state law enforcement agencies
• Enter data into a designated web portal and data systems
• Perform related duties as assigned by the Client

Job Requirements:

•  Broad experience with data collection and data entry.
•  Broad knowledge of the Indiana Criminal Code.
•  Thorough knowledge of the Client, as well as all levels of the Criminal Justice System.
•  Experience and comfortability with court documents and legal jargon
•  Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
•  Strong organizational and time management skills.
•  Ability to read and process data including information on crimes that is detailed, thorough, and contains sensitive material
•  Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with department staff and external agency staff.

Difficulty of Work:

•  Incumbent must be able to handle multiple, complex tasks and make good decisions based on his or her knowledge and understanding of each specific question and assignment.
•  Incumbent must use multiple methods in accomplishing an end result or outcome of a particular task and must be timely and accurate in completion of all tasks.
•  Incumbent’s work must be accurate. Consequences of inaccurate data include a negative public perception of the Client and potential public safety risks to the communities.
•  Incumbent works independently with work being reviewed on a periodic basis for accuracy, compliance with policy, and overall goals.

Personal Work Relationships:

•  Incumbent must maintain working relationships with all Department personnel to discuss projects related to their needs.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree required
• Master’s Degree preferred
• Equivalent work experience may also be considered

title: Lead Technical Support Engineer- ZTNA
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Technical Lead – ZTNA /Network Security to lead the technical and operational support function for enterprise customers using Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) and secure remote-access solutions. The role will lead a team of L2 ZTNA/Network Security engineers and serve as the primary technical escalation point for complex and critical customer issues. This is a hands-on technical leadership role that requires strong expertise in ZTNA, networking, security, troubleshooting, and major incident management, along with proven leadership and customer-facing capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

• Provide technical leadership and guidance to the L2 ZTNA support team.
• Act as the highest technical escalation point within Support before escalation to L3, Engineering, or R&D.
• Own and drive resolution of complex and critical customer issues.
• Guide engineers in structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
• Review technical troubleshooting performed by L2 engineers and ensure appropriate diagnostic processes are followed.
• Establish and maintain troubleshooting methodologies for recurring ZTNA and network-security issues.
• Promote evidence-based troubleshooting and minimize unnecessary escalations.

ZTNA & Network Security 

• Provide hands-on technical expertise in Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) and secure remote access.
• Troubleshoot VPN, SASE/SSE, and enterprise remote-access technologies.
• Work with identity-based access, authentication, and authorization solutions.
• Troubleshoot MFA, SSO, LDAP, and Active Directory integrations.
• Strong understanding of SAML, OAuth, and OIDC authentication protocols.
• Troubleshoot SSL/TLS, PKI, and certificate-related issues.
• Apply strong knowledge of DNS, TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, and proxy technologies.
• Troubleshoot enterprise applications and connectivity across Linux and Windows environments.
• Analyze complex production environments involving network, security, identity, and application dependencies.
Major Incident Management

• Lead P1/P2 major incident bridges and drive technical resolution.
• Coordinate with L1, L2, L3/R&D, Engineering, Product, and customer teams during critical incidents.
• Establish clear technical ownership and drive timely service restoration.
• Ensure effective and regular communication with customer stakeholders during major incidents.
• Review incident timelines and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Drive post-incident Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive actions.
• Identify recurring incidents and initiate problem-management activities.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

• Act as a senior technical point of contact for key enterprise customers.
• Participate in customer technical reviews, escalation calls, and service discussions.
• Understand customer environments, network architecture, and ZTNA deployment models.
• Communicate technical risks, findings, and remediation plans clearly to customer stakeholders.
• Collaborate with Customer Success, Professional Services, Sales, Engineering, and Product teams.
• Support technical discussions related to new deployments, upgrades, migrations, and changes.

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, mentor, and develop L2 ZTNA/Network Security support engineers.
• Allocate cases based on severity, complexity, and engineer capability.
• Monitor workload, backlog, SLA performance, and case quality.
• Conduct technical reviews of escalated cases.
• Identify technical skill gaps and define appropriate training plans.
• Conduct regular technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
• Establish effective shift coverage and escalation processes where required.
• Build a culture of technical ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Engineering & Product Collaboration 

• Work closely with L3, R&D, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve complex issues.
• Validate suspected product defects before escalation.
• Provide Engineering teams with complete logs, traces, configurations, troubleshooting findings, and reproduction steps.
• Track engineering escalations through to closure.
• Identify recurring product issues and recommend permanent corrective actions.
• Provide product feedback based on customer incidents and support trends.
• Participate in release-readiness, upgrade-impact, and deployment discussions where required.

Operational Excellence

• Drive operational metrics including SLA compliance, MTTA, MTTR, P1/P2 response, and backlog health.
• Improve escalation quality, troubleshooting effectiveness, and RCA quality.
• Monitor customer satisfaction and recurring incidents.
• Develop and maintain ZTNA troubleshooting guides, SOPs, escalation matrices, and incident checklists.
• Maintain Knowledge Base articles, known-error documentation, and technical support processes.
• Identify opportunities to improve support efficiency, service quality, and customer experience.

Mandatory Technical Skills & Experience

• 12+ years of experience in technical support, network security, ZTNA, VPN, SASE/SSE, or related enterprise security technologies.
• Strong hands-on experience with ZTNA / secure-access technologies.
• Strong understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals.
• Proven experience troubleshooting complex production environments.
• Strong knowledge of authentication and identity technologies.
• Strong understanding of SSL/TLS, PKI, and digital certificates.
• Experience working with Linux and Windows environments.
• Proven experience managing P1/P2 incidents and major customer escalations.
• Experience working closely with Engineering/R&D teams on complex technical issues.
• Strong customer-facing and stakeholder-management skills.
• Demonstrated experience in technical leadership, mentoring, and team guidance.

Good to Have

• Experience with enterprise ZTNA platforms.
• SASE / SSE experience.
• Cloud networking experience.
• SIEM, monitoring, or observability experience.
• Scripting experience with Python, Shell, or PowerShell.
• ITIL certification.
• CCNP, CISSP, Security+, or equivalent networking/security certifications.

Leadership Competencies

• Strong technical ownership and structured problem-solving ability.
• Ability to lead and coordinate critical incidents effectively.
• Ability to challenge assumptions and drive evidence-based troubleshooting.
• Excellent customer management and technical communication skills.
• Strong mentoring and team-development capabilities.
• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple high-severity incidents.
• Strong documentation, process, and governance discipline.
• Ability to collaborate effectively across Support, Engineering, Product, Professional Services, and Customer Success teams.

Key Performance Indicators

Success in this role will be measured through:

• SLA compliance
• P1/P2 MTTR improvement
• Escalation effectiveness and quality
• Customer satisfaction
• Support backlog health
• Reduction in repeat incidents
• RCA completion and quality
• Engineering escalation quality
• Team productivity and technical capability
• Knowledge Base and documentation development
• Reduction in customer escalations

title: Reports Developer
description:
• The Client requires the services of a report developer to provide business and systems analysis, modeling, design, and programming for FNS and SNAP reports development and maintenance operations using ORACLE, and PL\SQL programming technologies.
• The Client seeks a contractor to assist with implementation and maintenance of data extracts, ETL batch jobs, and reports, using Cúram Software product and Oracle. 
• The selected candidate will analyze and identify reporting requirements for NC FAST Case Management System reports and implement recommendations to effectively report data of mid to high level complexity. 
• This is related to varied business metrics and for designing, coding, testing, debugging, and documenting data interfaces and reporting solutions, while enhancing existing data extracts and reports to ensure that solutions continue to meet business needs.
• Selected candidate must understand the underlying data sources (databases) and interpret requirements provided by the business to analyze operational issues and develop appropriate diagnostic and/or tracking data via reports and dashboards.
• Duties include but are not limited to gathering and documenting requirements for new as well as changes to existing data extracts and report, developing complex queries against big tables storing CLOBS/XML, necessary supporting data structures, and report layouts, and writing effective SQL queries that perform well even against large tables. 
• This role will also analyze existing queries and report and query data to fix issues and extract data and develop and analyze operational performance metrics and reports to ensure the quality and integrity of extracts though the use of validation and audit strategies. This position will have responsibility for 24x7 On Call support/rotation.
Skills Required:
• Experience in using Oracle, Oracle Utilities, ETL tools	Required	5	Years
• Experience with PL/SQL scripting and Relational Database modeling.	Required	5	Years
• Experience with structured system development methodologies	Required	5	Years
• Ability to develop relationships/partnerships with customer by responding to needs and exhibiting an sense of urgency; independently identify options.	Required	5	Years
• Ability to organize, prioritize, and follow complex and/or detailed technical procedures.	Required	5	Years
• Experience with Business Intelligence tools such as Business Objects or BIRT	Required	5	Years
• Experience with Agile (Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe) development	Required	2	Years
• Data Warehouse experience	Required	2	Years
• Experience with developing dashboards with Power BI and Azure Synapse	Highly desired	2	Years
• Familiarity with Amazon RedShift & Tableau	Desired	2	Years

  • The selected candidate will analyze and identify reporting requirements for NC FAST Case Management System reports and implement recommendations to effectively report data of mid to high level complexity. 
  • This is related to varied business metrics and for designing, coding, testing, debugging, and documenting data interfaces and reporting solutions, while enhancing existing data extracts and reports to ensure that solutions continue to meet business needs.
  • Selected candidate must understand the underlying data sources (databases) and interpret requirements provided by the business to analyze operational issues and develop appropriate diagnostic and/or tracking data via reports and dashboards.
  • Duties include but are not limited to gathering and documenting requirements for new as well as changes to existing data extracts and report, developing complex queries against big tables storing CLOBS/XML, necessary supporting data structures, and report layouts, and writing effective SQL queries that perform well even against large tables. 
  • This role will also analyze existing queries and report and query data to fix issues and extract data and develop and analyze operational performance metrics and reports to ensure the quality and integrity of extracts though the use of validation and audit strategies. This position will have responsibility for 24x7 On Call support/rotation.
Skills Required:
  • Experience in using Oracle, Oracle Utilities, ETL tools Required 5 Years
  • Experience with PL/SQL scripting and Relational Database modeling. Required 5 Years
  • Experience with structured system development methodologies Required 5 Years
  • Ability to develop relationships/partnerships with customer by responding to needs and exhibiting an sense of urgency; independently identify options. Required 5 Years
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and follow complex and/or detailed technical procedures. Required 5 Years
  • Experience with Business Intelligence tools such as Business Objects or BIRT Required 5 Years
  • Experience with Agile (Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe) development Required 2 Years
  • Data Warehouse experience Required 2 Years
  • Experience with developing dashboards with Power BI and Azure Synapse Highly desired 2 Years
  • Familiarity with Amazon RedShift & Tableau Desired 2 Years

title: IT Trainer/Content Developer
description:
•  The Client is seeking a candidate who can travel to District and Area Office locations in District 1 (Gainesville), District 2 (Tennille, GA), to conduct on-premise classes several times a month and conduct classes remotely online through Microsoft   Teams. 
•  The job will be to deliver IT training to staff (adult learners) on custom IT developed and Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) applications. The Client will train the candidate in these products. Candidate will deliver training for desktop, web, and mobile applications. Candidate will work with users to identify training needs, courses, and content. Candidate will publish training schedules/course offerings within Client Learning Management System (Oracle/Workday), administer learner enrollments/testing/completions, assign grades/scoring or awarding of certifications. Candidate will send and review training surveys to obtain feedback to improve training delivery and IT products. Candidate will collaborate/develop relationships with business units to increase class enrollments and address technical needs. Candidate will also facilitate vendor or contractor delivered training.
• The candidate will develop/update/maintain IT training content. They will compile information to create PowerPoint presentations, IT Trainer Guides, Quick Reference Guides, User Manuals, Storyboards, Videos, and/or Computer Based Training. Candidate will engage technical staff to develop training content.
• The Client highly desires a candidate who can develop training content using Microsoft Word, Microsoft PowerPoint, Scribe, TechSmith Camtasia, Adobe Captivate, and/or Articulate 360/Storyline.
• Candidate will complete recordkeeping for tracking time/activities, timecards, performance indicators, and ensure submitted data is accurate.
• Candidate will be working as a team member within the IT organization and report to a Team Leader/Supervisor. The IT Training Team is composed of IT Trainers, Instructional Designers and a Team Leader. The team delivers training statewide on ~40 applications. Training courses cover a variety of transportation topics such as contract administration, material testing, construction inspections, asset management/maintenance, and emergency operations.

Core Competencies:

• Training: Employs a variety of instructional techniques; effectively obtains learner engagement; delivers competency-based learning; actively  seeks feedback to improve.
• Content Development: Produces high quality training content quickly with minimal rework.
• Communication: Routinely and effectively communicates with learners/customers; with Team Leader on work assignments/priorities, timelines, risks/issues, travel issues, etc.
• Teamwork and Cooperation: Supports their team and IT to accomplish common goals, objectives, projects, and tasks. Demonstrates a “can- do” or “team player” attitude. Assists in conducting scheduled classes when other instructors are unable to conduct (e.g. call in sick).
• Customer Service: Provides helpful, courteous, responsive, and knowledgeable service. Ensures customer IT needs/issues get routed to appropriate support staff/IT management. Demonstrates patience and empathy with learners. Honors commitments and provides follow-up/follow-through. Provides learning opportunities to meet business needs, offer the complete course catalog, and schedule classes               equitably across Districts.
• Results Orientation: Consistently delivers required business results; demonstrates successful attainment of performance indicators for courses, classes, and enrollments; sets and achieves achievable, yet aggressive goals; consistently complies with quality standards in meeting deadlines; maintains focus on achieving IT goals/objectives.
• Planning and Organization: Plans schedules, work assignments, and travel arrangements sufficiently in advance. Confirms work priorities and manages time effectively.
• Travel: Able and flexible in travelling to conduct scheduled on-site training.

Responsibilities:

• Adheres to the priorities, procedures, objectives, and guidance of their Team Leader and IT management.
• Keeps Team Lead fully informed of work schedule, technical issues/risks, or any travel or accommodation concerns. Proactively  communicates and takes steps with Team Leader and IT management to mitigate any issues/risks.
• Learns and maintains knowledge of IT applications to a level sufficient to effectively teach and guide learners in its use and operation.
• Maintains, coordinates, and communicates training schedules/course offerings with end users and stakeholders.
• Ensures training environments and data are ready prior to training classes.
• Conducts virtual classroom training, on-site classroom, and webinars/user group sessions.
• Establishes effective relationships throughout the organization, both within IT, Human Resources, and across business  units/customers/stakeholders to identify/address gaps in user training and solicit class enrollment.
• Reserves conference rooms/equipment, confirms enrollments before travel, makes appropriate travel arrangements, and travels safely.
• Conducts online training using Microsoft Teams and on-premise training in conference rooms/computer labs.
• Provides an engaging, interactive, and positive learning experience to learners.
• Maintains professionalism and order within the classroom to complete course objectives.
• Completes enrollments, course attendance/completions, and assigns appropriate scoring/grades within the LMS. Sends out surveys.
• Ensures correct recordkeeping within the LMS, timekeeping/work activity reporting, and performance indicator reporting.
• Ensures travel expenses, taxes, and forms are correct on billing statements, etc. Submits expense reports through appropriate systems and within expected timeframes. Complies with travel policies and reimbursement procedures.
• Reviews and updates training materials and documentation.
• Produces effective training content suitable to course audience. Publishes course materials as needed.
• Participates in IT projects. Provides user training support with IT product user acceptance testing, initial rollouts, and ongoing production operation.
• Able to adapt/respond in a dynamic, fast-paced, customer-focused IT environment.
Skills Required:

• Microsoft Office and Office 365 applications	Required	5	Years
• BA/BS in in communications, teaching, IT or similar field; or Associate Degree w/2 yr of IT experience; or IT Certifications w/4 yr IT experience	Required	4	Years
• Work experience in IT technical training or with computers, technology, IT applications/systems, and/or end user client support.	Required	4	Years
• Excellent verbal and written English language communication, presentation, and teaching skills	Required	5	Years
• Able and flexible to travel within the State of Georgia to provide scheduled in-person training classes	Required	1	Years
• Work experience in developing role-based end user training content for IT applications/systems	Highly desired	4	Years
• Experience in instructional design, visual design, storyboarding, writing instructional text, audio scripts/video scripts	Highly desired	2	Years
• Adobe Captivate	Highly desired	2	Years
• TechSmith Camtasia	Highly desired	2	Years
• Articulate 360/Storyline	Highly desired	2	Years
• Microsoft Teams	Highly desired	1	Years
• Work experience with maintaining training records within an LMS	Highly desired	1	Years
• Oracle LMS/Cornerstone LMS	Nice to have		
• Familiarity with ServiceNow	Nice to have

title: Senior Budget Officer/Technical Specialist- Senior
description:
• The Senior Budget Officer serves as the dedicated financial operations lead for the Health Information Exchange Authority (HIEA), ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely management of complex financial workflows across multiple IT systems and IT agencies. 
• This position oversees the full lifecycle of invoice tracking, documentation management, budget monitoring, and cross agency financial coordination. The Senior Budget Officer maintains structured financial documentation across multiple platforms, ensures timely and accurate processing of invoices, develops and updates dynamic budget dashboards, and monitors spending across major contracts and funding streams.
• The role serves as HIEA’s primary financial coordination point with the Client, DHB Finance, legal, privacy, security, procurement, contractors, and partner agencies, ensuring that all submissions—financial, contractual, and compliance related—are accurate, complete, and on schedule. The Senior Budget Officer proactively identifies and resolves financial issues, maintains standardized SOPs, and provides transparent financial reporting that supports leadership decision making to strengthen adherence to state, federal, and contractual compliance requirements, and ensure that HIEA’s financial operations function reliably and efficiently.

Skills Required:

• Experience managing financial aspects of healthcare IT programs	Required	7	Years
• Advanced Financial Operations & Budget Management	Required	7	Years
• Multi-System Financial Documentation & Data Management	Required	5	Years
• Cross-Agency Coordination & Compliance	Required	5	Years
• Invoice Lifecycle Management & Vendor Coordination	Required	5	Years
• Financial Analysis, Issue Resolution & Reporting	Required	5	Years

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
• Design and develop software applications using Twelve-Factor App methodology from functional requirements.
• Develop highly innovative UI design, Web components, achieved through collaboration and dialogue with other experts in the field. The candidate will continually assess advancements in technologies to gauge and recommend better solutions for the customer to improve the software developer experience and efficient delivery of software.
• Implementation of Graphical User Interface (GUI) using the presentation tier technologies such as AngularJS, ReactJS, Node JS, Type Script, JavaScript, JSP, HTML, CSS, XML, AJAX, and jQuery,.
• Front end development using modern JavaScript and experience with ES13+ features, such as classes, arrow functions, template literals and modules.
• Design Web Page components that are compliant with Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act (29 U.S.C. 794d).
• Design and develop Microservices using Spring Boot, Java and RESTful architecture.
• Solid understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and tools such as Jenkins, Git, Bitbucket, OpenShift and experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and containerization technologies.
• Develop and maintain Enterprise Java Batch application using Java Specification Request (JSR) 352 specification and schedule Java Batch jobs using Control-M.
• Develop Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) based Web Services using technologies such as JAX-WS, Apache Axis, and Web Services Description Language (WSDL). Implement Web Service Security using WS-Security using existing IBM DataPower infrastructure. Ensure interoperability with Web Services-Interoperability (WS-I) standards, and optimize message transmission using Message Transmission Optimization Mechanism (MTOM) or SOAP with Attachments (SWA).
• Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, QA, and project managers and commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with emerging technologies.
• Develop the Data Access Layer (DAO) to interface the application with IBM DB2 9.0 and PostgreSQL databases running on z/OS mainframe and Linux operating systems and other platforms, utilizing JPA or Spring Data API for querying and retrieving data through Object Relational Mapping (ORM).
• Create POCs, templates for developing Behavior Driven Development (BDD) test framework for the APIs using Cucumber, Gherkin, and Java to implement Integration tests.
• Develop unit test cases for every possible Java class with real scenarios using Junit, Mockito and Power Mock frameworks
• Use Visio, Confluence and IT Governance Frameworks to document the solution architecture & develop UML based design documents.
• Attend all customer technical discussions/design/development meetings and provide viable technical solutions to further enhance the existing architecture and improve code quality/process.
• Impact functional strategy by developing new solutions, processes, standards, or operational plans that position Leidos competitively in the marketplace.
• Provide guidance/support to other junior/mid-level developers.
• Experience as hands on Technical Lead
• All other duties as assigned or directed.

Key Required Skills:

• Strong experience with Java, OpenShift/ Amazon Web Services (AWS), Agile Development, Angular/React, JavaScript, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, and Web Services.

Skills Requirements:

• Foundation for Success (Basic Qualifications)
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.
• Masters or Doctorate degree may substitute for required experience
• 10+ years of experience with Java, Spring Boot, Angular, React.
• Extensive Design and Programming skills in Java and JEE technologies.
• Extensive hands-on experience with one or more frameworks such as Angular, React, and Express/Node.js.
• Experience as hands on Technical Lead
• Experience working on Agile projects and strong knowledge of Agile terminology and tools including Agility.
Factors To Help You Shine (Required Skills)
• Experience in designing high-throughput and low-latency systems, including architecting scalable solutions capable of handling large volumes of concurrent requests with minimal response times.
• Experience in developing the applications using Single-Page Application Architecture.
• Proficient in implementing efficient data processing pipelines, optimizing application performance through asynchronous processing, caching strategies, and load balancing.
• Experience in coding “responsive” web pages with an understanding of the cross-browser limitations and browser compliance standards.
• Experience designing and deploying cloud-native applications onto AWS with PostgreSQL.

title: Amazon Connect Developer
description:
Key Required Skills:

The successful candidate will have fluency in AWS Connect design and development principles and work with stakeholders to develop enterprise business solutions that leverages industry processes and best practices.

Position Description:

• Design, develop and implement AWS Connect processes to include new or modifications to applications, forms, workflow, policies, actions, access control, interfaces, and any other configurations required to support client processes
• Provide recommendations for enhancing existing operations and provide recommendations for new updates or modifications
• Support and enhance existing processes based on new requirements or upgrades
• Facilitate requirements gathering, review and document requirements
• Design and develop solutions within the ServiceNow environment
• All other duties as assigned or directed
Skills Requirements:

• Foundation for Success (Basic Qualifications)
• FOUNDATION FOR SUCCESS(Basic Qualifications)
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field
• 7 years of experience working with large enterprise framework
• 7 years of hands-on experience working with AWS Cloud platform
• 3 years of hands-on experience working with Amazon Connect
• 3 years of experience using Node.js, Python or Java for development
• 3 years of experience in designing call routing & messaging
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
Factors To Help You Shine (Required Skills)

• **Master's and 10+ years of experience, Bachelor's and 12+ years of experience or 18+ years in lieu of a degree**
• These skills will help you succeed in this position:
• Solid AWS Cloud and AWS Connect Developer experience
• Extensive experience and knowledge with IVR, Automatic Call Distribution (ACD), Skill-Based Routing, Live Chat
• Experience with process flow documentation creation.
• Experience with Lambda, Lex Conversational, Bots/NLP, Kinesis Streams, Glue, VPC, SMS (Simple Notification Service), AppSync, EventBridge, Kinesis Firehouse, DynamoDB Streams, Service Catalog, Kinesis Data Analytics
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.
• How To Stand Out From The Crowd (Desired Skills)
• Showcase your knowledge of modern development through the following experience or skills:
• Adept at working independently, but also in a team environment
• Demonstrated experience delivering technology solutions in a fast-paced, deadline driven enterprise environment
• Excellent understanding of change management, testing requirements, techniques, and tools to ensure high availability of systems
• Prior Federal government experience
• Self-starter, highly motivated individual who adapts to a dynamic work environment
• Strong attention to detail with an ability to operate effectively across multiple priorities

title: Tableau Developer
description:
Key Required Skills:

• SME on Tableau BI Dashboard development, Data Management & Analysis. Strong proficiency in Tableau Desktop and SQL PostgreSQL preferred) and NoSQL database (Mongo DB preferred) querying.
Position Description:

Dashboard Development

• Develop and enhance Tableau dashboards in enterprise environments
• Modify and extend existing reporting solutions.
• Utilize advanced Tableau Desktop features (parameter actions, LOD expressions, relationships/joins, complex interactions, custom visualizations).
• Design intuitive, visually clean, and story-driven dashboards focused on user experience
• Translate loosely defined requirements into polished, functional dashboards with minimal oversight
Data Management & Analysis

• Write and optimize SQL queries, especially in PostgreSQL environments
• Work with messy or imperfect data; identify and resolve data quality issues
• Troubleshoot and resolve Tableau performance issues (workbook optimization, calculations, filters, queries)
Testing & Quality Assurance

• Deliver accurate, thoroughly tested, and low-defect dashboards
• Perform dashboard testing, validation, and bug fixing, preferably in Agile/Scrum environments
• Follow written technical requirements and implementation instructions with minimal rework
Documentation & Communication

• Document dashboard changes, testing results, and technical implementation details
• Communicate proactively regarding risks, blockers, and implementation considerations
• Manage multiple enhancement requests, defects, and ad hoc analysis tasks efficiently
Skills Requirements:

• Foundation for Success (Basic Qualifications)
• 7+ years of experience with analysis, design and developing systems using skills identified in this requirement.
Factors To Help You Shine (Required Skills)

• **Master's and 5+ years of experience, Bachelor's and 7+ years of experience or 13+ years in lieu of a degree**
• Demonstrated experience with Tableau dashboard development and enhancement
• Strong proficiency in Tableau Desktop and SQL (PostgreSQL preferred) and NoSQL database (Mongo DB preferred) querying
• Experience with dashboard UX/UI principles and data quality troubleshooting
• Experience in Agile/Scrum development environments
• Experience in translating loosely defined requirements into polished, functional dashboards with minimal oversight
• Strong experience writing and optimizing SQL queries, especially in PostgreSQL environments
• Excellent Communication skills
How To Stand Out From The Crowd (Desired Skills)

• Familiarity with Snowflake or cloud data warehouse concepts
• Experience in government or public-section Agile environments
• Tableau Certification(s)

· Well versed with MAB Guidelines for Model based development
· Functional Testing and Debugging of models and code
· Code Integration (application and BSW), exposure to different IDE, compilers and debuggers

Good to Have:

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
Job Purpose:

The Accounts Payable Specialist is an important role in the Accounts Payable team to ensure the accurate processing and payment of vendor invoices and the operation of the related financial controls. The team uses the Esker Accounts Payable system to read all vendor invoices and integrate with SAP ERP system. The Accounts Payable Specialist will focus on supporting particular internal customers and work closely with stakeholders to resolve queries and issues to ensure invoices are processed accurately and paid in accordance with the agreed terms.

Responsibilities: 

Duties will include but are not restricted to:

•Process PO and Non PO invoices accurately and efficiently using Esker and SAP

•Download invoices from vendor portals and process them in Esker

•Maintenance of Esker for automation of invoice processing

•Obtaining of approval of Non-Purchase Order invoices in accordance with the Delegated Authorities

•Matching of invoice details to Purchase Order details

•Investigating supplier invoice queries

•Analyze and resolve items in the MRBR (Blocked Invoices) report

•Supporting Internal and External Audits

•Liaising with Purchasing teams for resolution of issues

•Actively participate in weekly collaboration calls with Finance Controllers and the Procurement team

•Monthly reconciliation of Intercompany Balances and accrual of missing invoices

•Post month end Esker Non PO accruals and perform timely reversals, ensuring accrual balances at the lowest possible

•Monitoring of the Concur SAP Cockpit and resolution of issues

•Other AP activities as required

Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

•4-6 years of experience of Accounts Payable

•Good working knowledge of SAP ECC6 is a must

•Experience of working within a Shared Service Centre 

•Fast learner with the ability to pick up new systems and processes

•Great attention to detail

•Good communicator with fluency in business English (written and spoken)

•Knowledge of another foreign language is an advantage  

•Excellent MS Office skills, particularly Excel (v-lookup, pivot tables) for data analysis

•Numerate with accounting knowledge

•Well organized with strong task management skills

Planning and Decision Making:

•  The ability to work to deadlines and on different shifts, as applicable
•  A flexible approach and the ability to work on own initiative is essential.
•  A good team player
Impact and Scope:  

• Ability to work in a Shared Service Centre environment for multiple companies from various countries  
• Ability to cope with month end reporting, tight deadlines
• Ability to create and maintain a good working environment within the finance team, independently manage actions and to resolve disputes
Key Internal and External Relationships:  

•Reporting to the AP Supervisor and interacting with Head of Accounts Payable SSC, as needed

•Local Procurement teams for resolving blocked invoices

•Financial Controllers for the approval of payment proposals and bank payments

•Contact with vendors to resolve queries and validate changes to sensitive financial information

title: Project Manager/Scrum Master
description:
About the Role

This role is a client-facing leadership position responsible for managing end-to-end project delivery while also acting as a Scrum Master for multiple Agile teams. The individual will be accountable for ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to customer expectations.Key Responsibilities:

• Drive end-to-end project management activities ensuring successful delivery within scope, timeline, and budget
• Owning the delivery end to end by exhibiting problem-solving skills
• Lead Agile ceremonies and act as Scrum Master for multiple cross-functional teams at the same time
• Owning the comprehensive Change management process at the customer side
• At the customer side, preparing & Managing project plans, sprint backlogs, and workflows
• Proactively suggesting improvements in the process and coming up with hard ($) savings/ soft savings (process improvements)
• Responding quickly to the customer ask
• Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to define priorities and align project goals
• Lead and mentor Project Management and Scrum teams
• Provide regular project status updates, identify risks, and drive mitigation plans
• Build strong client relationships through effective communication and stakeholder management
Required Skills:

• Project Management experience along with hands-on Scrum Master experience
• Strong expertise in JIRA and Monday.com (preferably at the admin level too)
• Experience in managing large teams (including 3rd party vendors) and leading PM/SM functions
• Scrum certified (CSM/PSM)
• Must have handled US/UK customers
• Confident personality with exceptional verbal and written communication skills
• Excellent stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills
• Experience working directly with Product Owners and Business Analysts
• Ability to work with US stakeholders in overlapping time zones

title: Senior EDI / B2B Business Analyst
description:
Key Responsibilities• Work with 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) and 4PL (Fourth-Party Logistics) providers to understand order, shipment, warehouse, inventory, fulfillment, and transportation integration requirements.

• Analyze end-to-end supply chain flows across ERP ? EDI/B2B Platform ? 3PL/4PL ? Warehouse/Carrier ? Customer.

• Gather and document requirements for onboarding new customers, suppliers, carriers, warehouses, 3PLs, and other trading partners.

• Analyze EDI transactions commonly used in logistics and fulfillment, including 850, 855, 856, 810, 940, 945, 943, 944, 846, 214, 204, 210, and 997/999, depending on the business process.

• Understand and document order-to-ship, warehouse fulfillment, inventory synchronization, ASN, transportation status, freight, invoicing, and acknowledgment flows.

• Coordinate partner-specific mappings, communication protocols, testing, certification, cutover, and production onboarding.

• Work with logistics and business teams to identify and resolve inventory discrepancies, shipment failures, missing ASNs, order exceptions, acknowledgment failures, and partner-specific mapping issues.

• Understand differences in integration and operating models across 3PL and 4PL providers, including multi-carrier and multi-warehouse environments.

• Support modernization of legacy EDI/3PL integrations toward API, event-driven, cloud-based, or hybrid integration architectures.

• Maintain trading partner profiles, implementation guides, mapping specifications, partner-specific business rules, SLAs, and onboarding documentation.

Required / Preferred Experience
3PL/4PL & Supply Chain Domain Experience• Hands-on experience working with 3PL and/or 4PL logistics providers.

• Strong understanding of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), Order Management Systems (OMS), ERP, fulfillment, inventory, and shipping processes.

• Experience integrating enterprise systems with external warehouses, logistics providers, carriers, suppliers, and customers.

• Strong understanding of trading partner onboarding and lifecycle management.

• Knowledge of EDI-based warehouse, transportation, order, shipment, inventory, and invoice transactions.

• Experience troubleshooting end-to-end transactions across multiple internal and external systems.

• Experience with platforms such as Cleo, IBM Sterling, OpenText, SEEBURGER, Boomi, MuleSoft, Axway, or equivalent B2B/EDI integration platforms is preferred.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Key Required Skills	

• Strong practical experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), Text Processing, and Information Extraction concepts including Named Entity Recognition, Blocking and Indexing, String Distance Metrics, TF-IDF/Cosine Similarity, Phonetics Encoding, Address Standardization
• Solid Python, Regex, and SQL experience
• Excellent Communication skills

Position Description	

• Develop Analytics Solutions: Design, implement, and maintain advanced data processing and entity resolution pipelines using Python and SQL on enterprise data platforms.
• Data Hygiene & Management: Clean, transform, and manage large-scale datasets from diverse, complex sources, ensuring absolute data integrity, reliability, and security.
• Performance Optimization: Optimize complex SQL queries and database operations to ensure efficient data access, processing, and scalability.
• Engineering Standards: Actively participate in code reviews, enforce version control, and uphold best practices for code quality, reproducibility, and data privacy.
• End-to-End Delivery: Support data validation, testing, deployment, and post-implementation monitoring in a fast-paced environment.

Detailed Skills Requirements	

• Foundation for Success (Basic Qualifications)
• Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or Information Science with experience in NLP, Text Processing, Information Extraction, Python, SQL, Regex and specialized libraries/frameworks.
• Overall 10+ years’ experience in IT industry
• **Master's and 10+ years of experience, Bachelor's and 12+ years of experience or 18+ years in lieu of a degree**
• Strong practical experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), Text Processing, and Information Extraction including:
• Practical knowledge of Named Entity Recognition and Address Standardization to extract and clean unstructured text data.
• Deep understanding of data matching strategies, including Blocking and Indexing, String Distance Metrics, and Phonetic Encoding.
• Experience applying TD-IDF and Cosine Similarity for text comparisons and information retrieval.
• Strong Python development skills for building analytics solutions and manipulating data.
• Advanced SQL proficiency for complex data querying, optimization, and database operations.
• Practical experience using Regex for advanced text processing, data cleansing, and pattern matching.

Familiarity with specialized libraries and frameworks including:

• Linkage libraries such as Splink / FastLink, Dedupe, or recordlinkage
• Core Python data science libraries, specifically spaCy for NLP tasks and Scikit-Learn for general machine learning and clustering
• Familiarity with code reviews, version control, and maintaining data security and reproducibility standards.
• Excellent communication skills.

How To Stand Out From The Crowd (Desired Skills)

• Prior experience delivering IT or data initiatives within federal, state, or local government environments
• Proven ability to operate independently, take ownership of data pipeline architectures, and drive projects from data discovery through to post-implementation.
• Experience retrieving, migrating, and manipulating data from legacy and distributed systems, including PostgreSQL, DB2, Oracle, SQL Server, and Hadoop, as well as unstructured flat files.
• Experience utilizing Jenkins to automate continuous integration, testing, and deployment (CI/CD) for data validation pipelines.
• Experience with pipeline automation tools to schedule and monitor complex data cleansing jobs.
• Strong ability to translate complex algorithmic decisions (such as probabilistic match thresholds) into clear business logic for executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and proven verbal/written communication skills when collaborating across cross-functional teams.

title: Senior Firmware Engineer – Fire & Safety Domain
description:
About Job Role 

We are seeking a hands-on Firmware Development Engineer,
with 7-10 years of experience, to develop, integrate, validate, and sustain
embedded firmware used in Fire Safety & Suppression and nitrogen
generation products. The role covers real-time control of compressors, motors,
solenoid valves, pressure and other sensors, alarms, user interfaces,
diagnostics, product configuration, and wired communications on
microcontroller-based platforms. The candidate must be able to understand an
existing codebase and product architecture, convert system and hardware
requirements into reliable firmware, debug issues on actual hardware, complete
regression testing and support the controlled production releases for both NPD
and VAVE programs. Success is measured by robust, traceable, production-ready
firmware that preserves safety, compliance, reliability, and field performance.

Key Responsibilities Firmware Development & Product
Implementation 

• Develop, maintain, and release to production the embedded
firmware for Fire Safety & Suppression and nitrogen-generation
products.
