title: NPD & VAVE Mid-Level Mechanical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a hands-on NPD & VAVE Mechanical Engineer, with 7-10 years of experience, to develop new products and implement value-engineering, redesign, and lifecycle improvements across fire suppression and nitrogen-generation products. The role combines mechanical system engineering for compressors, pneumatic and pressure circuits, tanks, membranes, filters, regulators, valves, tubing, and manifolds with detailed product design for sheet-metal enclosures, skids, brackets, mounting, vibration isolation, service access, and product integration. The candidate must be able to translate requirements into concepts, calculations, SolidWorks models, production drawings, BOMs, prototypes, verification evidence, and controlled engineering releases. Demonstrated hands-on contribution to both NPD and implemented VAVE or cost-reduction programs is required; this is not a teardown-only, costing-only, or CAD-documentation-only role. 

Key Responsibilities 

Value Engineering & Cost-Down Execution 

• Perform product teardown, functional decomposition, BOM/material analysis, benchmarking, and function-cost assessment, translate findings into NPD requirements and redesign opportunities. 

• Identify opportunities for part-count reduction, common components, alternate materials, simplified interfaces, target-cost achievement, platform reuse, and model-variant rationalization. 

• Develop VAVE and NPD concepts into complete mechanical designs, calculations, CAD models, prototypes, cost estimates, BOM and drawing updates, and release-ready engineering changes. 

• Ensure that new and redesigned products improve total value without compromising safety, performance, reliability, serviceability, installation, manufacturability, or compliance. 

Pneumatic, Compressor & Pressure-System Engineering 

• Translate product requirements into pneumatic and mechanical architectures and analyse compressor packages, air and nitrogen flow paths, membrane interfaces, water separators, filters, 

regulators, back-pressure regulators, solenoid valves, check valves, relief valves, gauges, pressure switches, drains, and unloaders. 

• Design and optimize tubing, hoses, NPT or equivalent fittings, manifolds, seals, receiver tanks, storage tanks, and Air Maintenance Device interfaces for new and existing products. 

• Perform engineering calculations for flow, pressure drop, fill time, compressor duty cycle, leakage, loads, forces, thermal effects, vibration, structural integrity, and safety margins as applicable. 

• Select and technically qualify compressors, valves, regulators, filters, fittings, tanks, and other mechanical or electromechanical components for NPD, redesign, and VAVE programs. 

Mechanical Product Design, Packaging & DFMA 

• Develop and optimize sheet-metal cabinets, doors, frames, brackets, compressor and tank mounts, vibration isolators, guards, handles, and service-access features for new products. 

• Create SolidWorks 3D parts and assemblies, layouts, detailed drawings, GD&T, tolerance stacks, material specifications, finish requirements, critical characteristics, and mechanical BOMs. 

• Apply DFM and DFA from concept stage through release to reduce fabrication steps, welding, machining, fasteners, assembly time, handling, tooling, inspection, rework, and installation effort. 

• Drive modularity and standardize cabinet, skid, bracket, mounting, fitting, fastener, and tank accessory architectures across representative product platforms. 

• Own prototype fabrication, fitment checks, assembly trials, design reviews, root-cause analysis, design iterations, corrective actions, and engineering-release updates. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Implementation 

• Own mechanical work packages on NPD, redesign, sustenance, and VAVE programs while working closely with the Senior Engineer, Electrical, Firmware, Validation, lab, and US stakeholders. 

• Define interfaces among compressor and motor packages, control panels, sensors, solenoid valves, controller enclosures, wiring, tanks, tubing, installation hardware, and field connections. 

• Release requirements, CAD models, drawings, BOMs, specifications, assembly requirements, test criteria, and ECO/ECN documentation through controlled PDM/PLM processes. 

• Provide technical support to US Supply Chain for supplier reviews, RFQs, component and process qualification, tooling, production trials, new-product launch, and VAVE implementation. 

Quantitative Analysis & Business-Case Development 

• Build target-cost and fact-based cost breakdowns covering material, fabrication, machining, welding, coating, purchased components, tooling, assembly labor, test, packaging, installation, warranty, and lifecycle impact. 

• Prepare concept and design trade-offs, feasibility assessments, target-cost analysis, ROI, payback, implementation effort, and risk inputs for NPD architecture and VAVE decisions. 

• Track NPD product cost against target and projected versus implemented VAVE savings, and support validation of recurring benefits with US Finance and Supply Chain. 

Validation, Compliance & Risk Management 

• Prepare mechanical and pneumatic requirements, DFMEA, design reviews, verification plans, tolerance analyses, and risk assessments for new and modified designs. 

• Plan and support DVP&R covering dimensional and functional performance, pressure and leak integrity, flow, nitrogen purity, fill time, compressor duty cycle, temperature, vibration, acoustics, endurance, transport, installation, and serviceability. 

• Assess impact on applicable UL, FM, NFPA, IEC, pressure-system, pressure-vessel, and regional tank-certification requirements and provide technical evidence to the Compliance team. 

Sustenance & Lifecycle Optimization 

• Use field-return, warranty, service, production, and maintenance data to identify reliability, costof-quality, serviceability, and next-generation product improvements. 

• Resolve component obsolescence, availability, quality, and supplier-process risks through technically validated alternatives and design changes. 

• Create reusable mechanical standards, preferred component and material strategies, common CAD models and drawings, design guidelines, test methods, VAVE practices, and lessons learned.
 

Qualifications 

• 7-10 years of mechanical product-design experience with demonstrated hands-on responsibility in both NPD and VAVE or cost-reduction programs for industrial or electromechanical products. 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Production Engineering, or a related discipline. 

• Demonstrated end-to-end contribution from requirements and concept development through detailed CAD design, prototype, verification, drawing/BOM release, and production support, 

including implementation of measurable mechanical cost reductions. 

• Practical experience with compressors, pneumatic systems, pressure vessels, valves, regulators, filters, tubing, fittings, manifolds, seals, and related electromechanical components. 

• Strong experience in sheet-metal product design, skids, enclosures, brackets, mounts, vibration isolation, material selection, GD&T, tolerance analysis, and industrial equipment packaging. 

• Strong hands-on proficiency in SolidWorks for 3D part and assembly modelling, configurations, sheet metal, routing, and detailed manufacturing drawings, with ownership of mechanical BOMs. 

• Strong working knowledge of the NPD lifecycle and VAVE methods, including requirements, architecture, product teardown, FAST or function analysis, benchmarking, design-to-cost, should

costing, material and process substitution, commonization, and platform strategy. 

• Practical knowledge of DFM, DFA, DFMEA, DVP&R, root-cause analysis, tolerance stacks, supplier process capability, PDM/PLM, configuration control, and engineering change release. 

• Ability to evaluate target cost and material, tooling, fabrication, assembly, test, packaging, installation, maintenance, warranty, service, and lifecycle cost impacts. 

• Strong hands-on capability with physical teardown, prototypes, measurement, fitment, assembly trials, laboratory test setups, failure analysis, design troubleshooting, and corrective action. 

• Ownership mindset and willingness to develop deep product knowledge of the assigned suppression and nitrogen-generator platforms and contribute to both NPD and VAVE roadmaps. 

• Willingness to travel periodically to locations, suppliers, manufacturing sites, and test laboratories as required. 

Core Competencies 

• Ownership Mindset | Product Development | Mechanical Systems Thinking | Design-for-Cost | DFM/DFA | Technical Rigor | Hands-on Execution | Reliability | Collaboration

• Develop VAVE and NPD concepts into complete mechanical designs, calculations, CAD models, prototypes, cost estimates, BOM and drawing updates, and release-ready engineering changes.

  • Perform electrical teardown, circuit/functional analysis, BOM analysis, benchmarking, and identify cost, commonization, simplification, wiring-reduction, platform-reuse, and variant-rationalization opportunities.
  • Convert VAVE concepts into complete electrical designs, prototypes, BOMs, engineering changes, and production-ready releases.
  • Apply design-to-cost during NPD and evaluate cost, performance, safety, reliability, compliance, schedule, ROI, and implementation risks.
  • Track NPD cost against targets and projected vs. implemented VAVE savings with Finance/Supply Chain.

AC Power, Motors & Industrial Controls

  • Design and troubleshoot 230/240 VAC 1-phase and 3-phase, 50/60 Hz systems; experience with 415/460/480 VAC is desirable.
  • Select, size, and validate AC motors/compressor packages up to approximately 7.5 HP.
  • Design/evaluate motor starters, contactors, overload relays, breakers, fuses, phase protection, control transformers, soft starters, VFDs/drives, as applicable.
  • Develop and troubleshoot control panels, wiring diagrams, terminal blocks, PE/grounding, harnesses, interlocks, relays, indicators, emergency/fault circuits, and controlled devices.
  • Integrate solenoid valves, unloaders, actuators, pressure switches, sensors, and other electromechanical devices.
  • Validate inrush/starting current, phase sequence/rotation, steady-state current, power, thermal behaviour, overload protection, fault response, functional sequence, and safe isolation.

Embedded Hardware

  • Develop/redesign microcontroller-based analog, digital, and mixed-signal hardware.
  • Design AC-DC/DC-DC/LDO power supplies, sensor interfaces, relay/contactors/solenoid drivers, dry-contact I/O, and protection circuits.
  • Work with SPI, I2C, UART, RS-485, CAN, Ethernet, USB, displays/keypads, DIP/configuration inputs, as applicable.
  • Own hardware requirements, schematics, component selection/derating, PCB layout review, board bring-up, debugging, verification, and engineering release.
  • Design for EMC, ESD, surge, EFT, transients, creepage/clearance, grounding, isolation, signal integrity, and electrical safety.
  • Promote reusable circuit blocks, common controller platforms, and configuration-based product variants.

Cross-Functional & Product Implementation

  • Own electrical work packages across NPD, redesign, sustenance, and VAVE projects.
  • Coordinate with Mechanical, Firmware, Validation, Manufacturing, Suppliers, and global stakeholders on electrical-mechanical and hardware-firmware interfaces.
  • Support prototype builds, supplier reviews, qualification, design transfer, production trials, and product launch.

Compliance, Reliability & Lifecycle

  • Conduct electrical DFMEA, design reviews, component derating, fault analysis, verification planning, and change-risk assessments.
  • Ensure designs meet requirements for electrical safety, motor/panel protection, EMC, reliability, serviceability, and field performance.
  • Resolve component obsolescence, single-source, availability, quality, and supplier risks through validated alternatives.
  • Use field-return, warranty, service, and production-test data to drive reliability and cost improvements.
  • Establish reusable design blocks, preferred components, wiring/controller strategies, test methods, standards, and lessons learned.

Qualifications

  • 7–10 years of relevant electrical/electronic product engineering experience with hands-on ownership of NPD and implemented VAVE/cost-reduction projects.
  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electrical, Electronics, E&T, Mechatronics, or related engineering discipline.
  • Proven experience from requirements/concept ? architecture ? detailed design ? prototype ? verification ? engineering release ? production support. Costing-only, sourcing-only, or proposal-only experience is insufficient.
  • Strong practical knowledge of 230/240 VAC 1-phase/3-phase systems, 50/60 Hz, AC motors, compressors, starters, contactors, overloads, fuses, breakers, panel wiring, and solenoid-controlled equipment.
  • Hands-on experience with microcontroller hardware, analog/digital interfaces, power conversion, sensor conditioning, drivers, communications, PCB design support, bring-up, and debugging.
  • Ability to create electrical requirements, schematics, wiring diagrams, single-line diagrams, cable schedules, PCB schematics, BOMs, test specifications, and controlled-release documentation.
  • Working knowledge of NPD, VAVE, design-to-cost, teardown, benchmarking, BOM analysis, component standardization, alternate qualification, DFM, DFMEA, DVP&R, and cost-benefit analysis.
  • Experience with compressors, pumps, industrial process equipment, fire/life-safety, suppression, nitrogen generation, or comparable regulated electromechanical products is preferred.
  • 415/460/480 VAC, motor drives/VFDs, soft starters, power-quality analysis, and 3-phase commissioning experience is desirable.
  • SAVE/VMA, Lean Six Sigma, or formal VAVE training is advantageous; hands-on NPD and implemented VAVE experience is mandatory.

NPD & Product Development | VAVE & Design-to-Cost | Electrical Safety | AC Power & Motor Controls | Embedded Hardware | Circuit/System Thinking | Reliability | Hands-on Execution | Cross-Functional Collaboration | Continuous Improvement | Ownership Mindset

title: ADP Workforce Now / Dayforce Platform SME
description:
The Client is seeking an experienced Dayforce Platform SME or ADP Workforce Now SME with strong expertise in plan configuration, plan build, and file feed integration. The ideal candidate will be responsible for configuring and maintaining HR, benefits, payroll, and related plans while ensuring accurate and efficient data exchange between the HR platform and internal or external systems and vendors.

This individual will serve as a subject matter expert for either the Ceridian Dayforce or ADP Workforce Now platform, supporting system configuration, file feed setup, troubleshooting, testing, and ongoing optimization.

Key Responsibilities• Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Dayforce or ADP Workforce Now.
• Configure, build, and maintain benefit, payroll, HR, and other business-related plans within the platform.
• Translate business requirements into effective system and plan configurations.
• Configure and manage outbound and inbound file feeds to support data exchange with internal systems and external vendors.
• Work with file formats such as 834 EDI, CSV, and other HR/payroll data files.
• Perform data mapping, validation, and testing to ensure accurate file transmission and system integration.
• Troubleshoot and resolve plan configuration, data, file feed, and integration issues.
• Partner with HR, Payroll, Benefits, IT, and external vendors to support system functionality and data requirements.
• Conduct system testing, quality assurance, and validation for new configurations and file feeds.
• Support ongoing system enhancements, configuration changes, and process improvements.
• Ensure configurations and data exchanges align with business, regulatory, and compliance requirements.
• Maintain documentation for plan configurations, file specifications, mappings, processes, and issue resolutions.
• Provide functional support and guidance to internal teams and stakeholders.
Required Qualifications• Strong hands-on experience as a Dayforce Platform SME or ADP Workforce Now SME.
• Demonstrated experience with plan configuration and plan build within Dayforce or ADP Workforce Now.
• Experience configuring and maintaining file feeds and data integrations.
• Knowledge of file formats including 834 EDI, CSV, and other structured data files.
• Strong understanding of HR, Benefits, Payroll, and/or HRIS processes.
• Experience troubleshooting configuration, data, and integration issues.
• Knowledge of data mapping, validation, and file transmission processes.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams and external vendors.
• Strong communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications• Experience with both Ceridian Dayforce and ADP Workforce Now platforms.
• Experience with benefits administration and payroll integrations.
• Knowledge of HR data interfaces and vendor integrations.
• Experience with EDI transactions, particularly 834 benefit enrollment files.
• Familiarity with system implementation, enhancement, or migration projects.
• Experience working in a fast-paced environment managing multiple configuration and integration priorities.

Implemented in 1996, available on every desktop, and used by over 2,000 social workers and case managers, the application has been enhanced and modified continually to meet data capture and process functionality requirements driven by good child welfare case practice as well as State and Federal legislation and statute.  Additionally, LINK continues to experience change chiefly in compliance with the 1991 Juan F. Consent Decree as well as the agency’s ongoing goal of improving the safety, permanency and well-being of children in care.  The agency is currently committed to developing the next generation Comprehensive Child Welfare information system (CCWIS) and has invested significant resources to ensure that Connecticut has efficient, economic and effective tools to aid our Child Welfare Staff, Providers and the children and families of 
• Information Systems provides technology expertise and services as well as an information systems infrastructure to the agency and its roughly 3,300 employees.  DCF Information Systems strives to improve continually improving technology services that are cost-effective and of the highest effectiveness and quality.

• The agency needs the service of a senior level Full Stack Developer. The candidate will serve in the capacity of a Developer participating in various SDLC processes including requirements verification, design and development, testing, maintenance, and support activities per the direction of agency management. The specific focus of this candidate will be the to be part of the team which supports existing custom Salesforce applications as well as to participates in the SDLC process of the new  KIND system and work with the System Integrator to ensure the transfer of knowledge and on-going maintenance of the solution for a given module.   The candidate must have a minimum of 5 years of Salesforce development. Must know foundational OOP in apex.

• Must be very organized, pro-active and self-directed.
• Must be self-starter and driven.  Must Drive the work from requirements to implementation.

• Bd  Provide analysis/requirements to integrate applications.
• Work on all phases of SDLC and create/maintain required technical documentation.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Refer to the contracts for IT Professional Services Agreement (22PSX0163) for experience and skill requirements for the job classification Solution Architect to fill the role.  In addition, the agency requires:
• For this position, the candidate shares experience and judgment with team to plan and accomplish goals, mentors less experienced staff, a wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected. In addition, the agency requires:
• An experience professional with 10 or more years of prior experience demonstrating the following knowledge and skills:
• Salesforce (min: 5 years) Must be able to code APEX OOP and know design patterns.
• .NET OOP and SOA
• JavaScript Frameworks preferred
• SQL
• End-to-End Web Development

title: Juvenile Teaching Assistant
description:
• The incumbent serves as a Teaching Assistant in a juvenile correctional facility. 
• The incumbent supervises students in the classroom in the absence of the classroom teacher with the following responsibilities: Attendance Taking, Behavior Monitoring, Assignment Monitoring, and Daily Record Monitoring. Furthermore, the Teaching Assistant provides students with guidance in completing assignments left by the classroom teacher and to support classroom instruction as needed.
• The incumbent is responsible for effectively managing the classroom. Incumbent participates in faculty and professional meetings. 
• The Teaching Assistant reports directly to the School Principal and performs duties with minimal supervision.

RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES TO BE PERFORMED WITH OR WITHOUT REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION:

ESSENTIAL DUTIES MAY INCLUDE:

• Following policy in critical incidents preventing injury, escape, or property damage.
• Maintains confidentiality.
• Incumbent supervises the daily work of students and evaluates the achievement of individual student knowledge.
• Operates all job-related equipment.
• Collaborates with other in order to enhance the learning environment of students.
• Providing written reports to/participates in multidisciplinary treatment team.
• Attending and successfully completing all required training and certifications.
• Developing and reviewing clear, accurate, and concise reports that are in compliance with policies and procedures.
• Promoting good working relationship with students, staff, contractual personnel, interns and volunteers, and applicable community public or private agencies.
• Maintaining a positive image to the public in all related responsibilities.
• Performs related duties as assigned.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DIFFICULTY OF WORK WITH OR WITHOUT REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION MAY INCLUDE:

• Ability to implement daily and weekly teacher lesson plans designed to enforce full course objectives in the absence of an educator.
• Ability to create and provide a positive learning environment conducive to and supportive of individual growth and development of students.
• Ability to maintain and control educational supplies, equipment, and tools.
• Ability to effectively communicate both orally and written.
• Ability to work effectively in a teamwork environment.
• Ability to accept supervision and constructive feedback.
• Ability to test negative on all drug tests.
• Ability to successfully complete all required training and certifications.

title: ServiceNow Lead
description:
As a ServiceNow - Lead, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting ServiceNow ITSM solutions that enable efficient service management and digital transformation across the organization. You will work closely with business stakeholders, service owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable ServiceNow solutions, enhance IT processes, and ensure platform stability, performance, and governance. This role offers an opportunity to work on enterprise ServiceNow implementations, integrations, and process automation initiatives while contributing to continuous service improvement.

Responsibilities: -

• Own the architecture, technical design, development, and implementation of additional ServiceNow ITOM features.
• Design and implement capabilities across Event Management, AIOps, Service Mapping, Certificate Management, Health Log Analytics, Metric Intelligence, and automated remediation.
• Technically hands-on in configuration, scripting, integration development, testing, debugging, deployment, and production issue resolution.
• Configure event ingestion, normalization, filtering, deduplication, correlation, prioritization, service impact, and automated remediation.
• Build and enhance event rules, management rules, correlation rules, service models, operational dashboards, flows, subflows, and remediation workflows.
• Develop custom scripts, Script Includes, Business Rules, Flow Designer actions, Scripted REST APIs, Import Sets, Service Graph Connectors and Transform Maps.
• Integrate ServiceNow with monitoring, observability, infrastructure, cloud, network, and automation platforms using APIs, IntegrationHub, webhooks, and MID Servers.
• Develop proofs of concept and prototypes to validate complex ITOM features and integration approaches.
• Troubleshoot event ingestion, correlation, service impact, data mapping, integrations, workflows, and platform performance issues.
• Ensure new ITOM features align with the existing CMDB, CSDM, ITSM processes, security model, platform standards, and performance requirements.
• Conduct code reviews and enforce secure, reusable, maintainable, high-performing, and upgrade-safe development practices.
• Support upgrades, regression testing, deployment, and production stabilization for newly implemented ITOM features.
• Lead technical workshops and mentor developers while serving as the escalation point for complex ITOM and integration issues.
• Proactively identify opportunities to extend ITOM capabilities and improve operational efficiency..

Experience: -

• 8+ years of overall IT experience, including 5+ years of ServiceNow experience.
• 5+ years in a ServiceNow ITOM Architect, Solution Architect, or senior technical leadership role.
• Significant and proven hands-on experience in designing and implementing enterprise-scale ServiceNow ITOM and CMDB solutions.
• Proven experience working with extending ITOM functionality complex, highly integrated, and customized ServiceNow environments.
Location: -

• Hyderabad

Educational Qualifications: -

• BE/BTech/ME/MTech/MCA/MSc.
• ServiceNow CSA (Certified System Administrator) preferred.
• ServiceNow CAD (Certified Application Developer) and CIS-ITSM certifications are an added advantage.
• ITIL Foundation Certification preferred
• Safe/Agile Certifications preferred
Skills: -

Mandatory Technical Skills: -

• Strong experience as a technically hands-on ServiceNow ITOM Architect on end to end implementations.
• Deep knowledge of Event and Management, event normalization, deduplication, correlation, Service Mapping, service visibility, AIOps, Certificate Management, Health Log Analytics, Metric Intelligence, and automated remediation.

title: Presales Lead (North)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and customer-focused Presales Lead to drive technical solutioning, customer engagement and sales support for enterprise customers. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in virtualization, cybersecurity, endpoint management, networking and enterprise infrastructure along with excellent stakeholder management and presentation skills.

The Presales Lead will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering and Customer Success teams to understand customer requirements, design scalable solutions and support revenue growth through effective technical consulting.

Key Responsibilities

• Engage with enterprise customers to understand business, technical and security requirements.

• Work closely with sales teams during customer meetings, discovery sessions and technical discussions.

• Deliver product demonstrations, technical presentations, workshops and proof of concepts (POCs).

• Design and propose secure digital workspace and remote access solutions aligned with customer environments.

• Prepare solution architecture documents, technical proposals, BOMs and RFP/RFI responses.

• Lead technical discussions with CXOs, IT Heads, Security teams and infrastructure stakeholders.

• Coordinate with internal product and support teams to address customer requirements and technical escalations.

• Support channel partners and system integrators on solution positioning and technical enablement.

• Drive successful execution of POCs and ensure smooth transition to implementation teams.

• Stay updated with industry trends, cybersecurity practices and competitor offerings.

• Mentor and guide junior presales engineers and support team capability development.

Experience & Qualification

• 10+ years of experience in Presales, Solution Consulting, Solution Architecture or Technical Sales roles.

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or related field.

• Relevant certifications in VMware, Microsoft, Networking or Cybersecurity would be an added advantage.

Preferred Candidate Profile

• Self-driven and consultative professional with strong problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience working in a fast-paced SaaS or cybersecurity environment.

• Ability to build trusted advisor relationships with enterprise customers.

• Comfortable with customer travel and onsite engagements when required.

     Web Services (primary), with exposure to Microsoft Azure as a
     plus.

Amazon EKS, Amazon S3, Amazon RDS  

Ø  Networking via
Amazon VPC, Elastic Load Balancing, Amazon Route 53  

Ø  Security using
AWS Identity and Access Management and AWS Secrets Manager

Bitbucket

services such as AWS CodePipeline and AWS CodeBuild

Ø 
Prometheus,

     pipelines

title: Technical Lead / Team Lead
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a technically sharp and people-oriented Technical Lead / Team Lead to anchor our Infrastructure & Virtualization support and delivery function. You will be the go-to expert for complex escalations involving virtual desktop environments, network topology, and operating system internals — while simultaneously guiding a team of support and implementation engineers to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

This is a hybrid individual-contributor and leadership role: you will both roll up your sleeves on tough technical problems and coach your team to build long-term capability.

Core Technical Domains

Virtualization & VDI

• Deep hands-on expertise with VMware vSphere / ESXi, Hyper-V, or KVM — cluster setup, HA/DRS configuration, and capacity planning
• Experience with VDI platforms: Citrix Virtual Apps & Desktops, VMware Horizon, or HyWorks (preferred)
• Understanding of desktop pooling models (persistent/non-persistent), session brokering, profile management, and application delivery
• Thin client / HyDesk endpoint configuration and management
Networking

• Strong fundamentals in TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing protocols (OSPF/BGP basics), and network segmentation
• SSL VPN / IPsec tunnels, reverse proxy, load balancers, and firewall rule management
• Hands-on with ZTNA / SD-WAN concepts; familiarity with HySecure or comparable products is a strong advantage
• Packet analysis using Wireshark or similar for deep-dive troubleshooting
Operating Systems
• Expert-level Windows Server (2016/2019/2022): AD DS, Group Policy, ADFS, IIS, RDS/RDG, certificate management
• Proficient in Linux administration (RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu): shell scripting, systemd, log analysis, package management
• Experience with OS hardening, patch management, and baseline configuration in enterprise environments
• Familiarity with containerisation concepts (Docker/Kubernetes) is advantageous
Key Responsibilities

• Own complex technical escalations (L2/L3) across virtualization, networking, and OS layers; drive root cause analysis and ensure timely resolution
• Lead, mentor, and performance-manage a team of 3–8 support / implementation engineers
• Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Pre-Sales teams to relay customer feedback and influence the product roadmap
• Define and maintain runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles for recurring issue categories
• Drive CSAT and SLA compliance metrics for your team's ticket queue; report weekly to support leadership
• Participate in customer onboarding, proof-of-concept, and go-live support for key accounts
• Provide inputs into hiring, training plans, and team structure as the function scales
• Serve as an escalation point of contact for strategic customers and partner engineers
Qualifications & Experience

• B.E. / B.Tech / MCA in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or equivalent; advanced certifications are a plus
• 5–9 years of experience in infrastructure support, solutions engineering, or IT operations
• At least 1–2 years in a lead, senior engineer, or subject-matter-expert role
• Certifications preferred: VCP-DCV, MCSE, RHCSA/RHCE, CompTIA Network+ / Server+, or equivalent
• Prior experience in a product company, IT infrastructure vendor, or managed services environment is highly preferred
Leadership & Soft Skills
• Proven ability to lead a team under pressure while maintaining a calm, solutions-oriented approach
• Clear and confident communicator — comfortable with customer-facing escalation calls and internal stakeholder updates
• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving mindset; able to break down ambiguous issues methodically
• Collaborative team player who leads by example; invested in the growth of team members
• Self-driven, ownership-oriented, with high accountability to outcomes
What We Offer

• Opportunity to work at the intersection of cybersecurity, infrastructure, and innovation
• Competitive compensation with performance-linked components
• Access to cutting-edge products and a fast-growing partner ecosystem
• Structured learning & development with support for professional certifications
• Collaborative, ownership-driven culture with real career progression pathways

title: Learning Designer
description:
Key responsibilities 
• Design and build high-quality digital, virtual and face-to-face learning experiences from raw materials (PPTs, videos, documents, SME input). 
• Engineer learning journeys that are engaging, modular and scalable within 360Learning and SuccessFactors. 
• Apply instructional design, learning science and UX principles to optimise learner experience. 
• Create reusable templates, patterns and assets to accelerate content development across academies. 
• Partner with SMEs and academy leads to shape learning journeys and assets, working mostly independently in line with agreed requirements.  
• Rapidly prototype, test and iterate learning assets based on learner feedback and usage data. 
• Ensure consistency of learning standards, tone and quality across enterprise and business academies. 
• Collaborate closely with the learning technologist on platform functionality and optimisation. 

Essential experience and skills 

• Strong instructional design and learning experience design background. 
• Hands-on experience creating digital learning content and journeys at scale. 
• Solid understanding of adult learning theory and digital pedagogy. 
• Proven ability to work with multiple stakeholders with short timelines for completion. 
• Comfort working directly with imperfect or unstructured source material. 
• Experience designing for social, cohort-based or collaborative learning models (desirable). 
• Strong visual, written and interaction design sensibility. 
• Ability to work fast without sacrificing quality. 
• Practical experience with learning platforms or authoring tools (360Learning experience a strong advantage).

title: Motion and Graphic Designer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a versatile Motion & Graphic Designer with strong command of Adobe Suite, solid graphic design skills, and working knowledge of Figma will be a plus. The ideal candidate can translate scripts and written ideas into engaging motion visuals and high quality static designs. Familiarity with Generative AI tools is considered an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities • Produce motion graphics, animations, and video content based on creative briefs.
 • Edit and refine video content using Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.
 • Design digital creatives, marketing graphics, and brand-aligned assets.
 • Build layouts, UI components, and visual mockups using Figma when required.
 • Collaborate with internal teams to deliver consistent and effective visual communication.
 • Use Generative AI tools to accelerate design and animation workflows.
Required Skills • 2+ years of experience
 • Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator.
 • Strong motion design & graphic design capabilities.
 • Working knowledge of Figma (design systems, components, prototyping) will be an advantage.
 • Strong understanding of typography, layout principles, visual hierarchy, and color theory.
 • Ability to manage multiple design tasks with accuracy and attention to detail.
 • Knowledge of Generative AI tools for design and motion production.
 • Experience with 3D design tools (Blender, Cinema 4D) is a plus.
Candidate Profile • Creative, detail oriented, and skilled in visual storytelling.
 • Capable of delivering polished outputs under deadlines.
 • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
 • Open to learning new tools, techniques, and workflows.

title: Full Stack Developer (Mid-Level)
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a Mid-Level Full Stack Developer with 5-10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be proficient in developing and maintaining both front-end and back-end applications, contributing to all phases of the software development lifecycle, and working with a modern tech stack. You will be responsible for building scalable and reliable systems, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring the performance and security of our applications.Key Responsibilities• Design and Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable web applications using Python for the back end and React.js for the front end.
• Database Management: Manage and optimize databases, specifically PostgreSQL, for performance and data integrity.
• Cloud Infrastructure: Deploy, manage, and scale applications on AWS, leveraging services like EC2, S3, RDS, and others.
• System Integration: Integrate and work with large-scale data processing systems using Apache Hadoop and real-time data pipelines with Apache Kafka.
• Performance Optimization: Write high-performance microservices and APIs using Golang.
• Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define, design, and ship new features.
• Code Quality: Write clean, well-documented, and testable code, participating in code reviews to maintain high standards.
• Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve bugs, bottlenecks, and performance issues across the stack.
Required Skills & Qualifications• Experience: 5-10 years of professional experience as a Full Stack Developer.
• BE BTech M.tech MCA Comp Sc
• Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python and Golang.
• Front-End: Expertise in React.js and its ecosystem (Redux, Hooks, etc.).
• Back-End: Experience with building RESTful APIs and microservices.
• Databases: Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization.
• Cloud: Solid understanding of AWS services and cloud-native application development.
• Big Data/Streaming: Practical experience with Apache Hadoop and Apache Kafka.
• Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a strong attention to detail.
• Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.
Preferred Qualifications• Experience using Agentic AI systems for software development.

  • Design and Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable web applications using Python for the back end and React.js for the front end.
  • Database Management: Manage and optimize databases, specifically PostgreSQL, for performance and data integrity.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Deploy, manage, and scale applications on AWS, leveraging services like EC2, S3, RDS, and others.
  • System Integration: Integrate and work with large-scale data processing systems using Apache Hadoop and real-time data pipelines with Apache Kafka.
  • Performance Optimization: Write high-performance microservices and APIs using Golang.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define, design, and ship new features.
  • Code Quality: Write clean, well-documented, and testable code, participating in code reviews to maintain high standards.
  • Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve bugs, bottlenecks, and performance issues across the stack.
Required Skills & Qualifications
  • Experience: 5-10 years of professional experience as a Full Stack Developer.
  • BE BTech M.tech MCA Comp Sc
  • Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python and Golang.
  • Front-End: Expertise in React.js and its ecosystem (Redux, Hooks, etc.).
  • Back-End: Experience with building RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Databases: Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Cloud: Solid understanding of AWS services and cloud-native application development.
  • Big Data/Streaming: Practical experience with Apache Hadoop and Apache Kafka.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a strong attention to detail.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience using Agentic AI systems for software development.

title: Telecommunication Analyst
description:
Key Responsibilities:  

  • Conduct market intelligence research to identify trends,

     pricing benchmarks, and emerging technologies in the telecommunications

     space. 

  • Analyze Clients current telecom spends, usage, and vendor

     performance across internet access, voice, data, circuits, and SD-WAN. 

  • Collaborate with procurement teams and IT stakeholders to

     support RFPs, vendor negotiations, and contract reviews. 

  • Provide insights and recommendations to optimize telecom

     services and reduce costs while maintaining service quality. 

  • Support the development of category strategies and sourcing

     plans aligned with Client's global IT objectives. 

  • Maintain and update telecom inventory, usage reports, and

     dashboards for internal stakeholders. 

  • Partner with cross-functional teams including IT, Finance, and

     Legal to ensure alignment and compliance. 

  • Monitor and report on telecom service performance, SLAs, and

     vendor risk. 

  • Conduct a thorough review and negotiation of contract terms

     prior to execution. 

  • Drive Supplier relationship and coordinate business reviews

     with telecom vendors.  

  • Collaborate with Category manager to align with the global

     strategy.  

  • Drive initiates for Year-on-Year cost optimization and savings.

      

   

Qualifications:  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Information

     Technology, Business, or related field. 

  • 5+ years of experience in telecommunications analysis,

     sourcing, or network operations. 

  • Strong understanding of:  
    
      • Internet access technologies 

      • Voice and data services 

      • Circuit provisioning and optimization 

      • Network architecture and SD-WAN solutions  

    
  

  • Experience with market intelligence tools and telecom expense

     management platforms. 

  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management

     skills. 

  • Ability to work independently in a remote, global team

     environment. 

   

Preferred Skills:  

  • Experience in global telecom sourcing or vendor management. 

  • Familiarity with telecom regulatory environments and compliance

     standards. 

  • Knowledge of cloud-based networking and digital transformation

     initiatives.

title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
About the Role

We’re seeking a seasoned Lead Data Scientist to lead NLP/ML research efforts and architect end-to-end solutions. You will be instrumental in driving innovation, mentoring junior team members, and working closely with stakeholders to align AI capabilities with strategic goals.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the development and deployment of production-grade NLP and ML models.

• Work with large language models (LLMs), RoBERTa, GPT APIs, and hybrid architectures.

• Guide and review the work of junior scientists and interns.

• Develop pipelines for training, evaluation, and continuous model monitoring.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to scope new projects and define success metrics.

• Write technical papers, PoCs, and support patentable innovations when applicable.

Required Skills

     • 5+ Years of relevant experience along with prior exposure to team leadership responsibilities.

• 5+ Years of deep knowledge of modern NLP architectures (transformers, LLMs, embeddings).
• Design, build, and deploy Generative AI models (e.g., LLMs, Diffusion Models) into production systems.
• Strong understanding of Neural Networks, Transformer models (e.g., BERT, GPT), and deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
• Proficiency in Python and ML libraries (e.g., Scikit-learn, Hugging Face, Keras, OpenCV). 
• Proficiency in data pipelines, MLOps, model versioning, and evaluation frameworks.
• Ability to distill complex problems and explain them clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Preferred Qualifications

• Published work in conferences/journals or experience contributing to open-source projects.

• Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS), LangChain, or prompt engineering.

• Experience in managing research interns or small AI/ML teams.

Education

Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.

title: HR Payroll Executive
description:
Job Responsibilities

  •  Responsible for processing payroll for 100 employees. To manage the payroll process and ensure 100% accuracy, timely execution and adherence to the Local Labor Laws and internal SOP's. This includes all payroll related reporting as required including and not limited to salary registers/summaries, reconciliations of costs/ provisions and statutory reporting.

  •  Work with the payroll vendor and ensure employee query and communications are handled effectively.

  •  Ensure the organization's compliance with payroll tax reporting and withholding responsibilities.

  •  Encourage constant employee communication channels to build awareness amongst employees about investments, payroll and reimbursement process etc.

  •  100 % compliance of the monthly filing of mandatory returns. Maintain and close all filings pertaining to labor department requirements

  •  Comply with all the payroll financial and legal requirements, responsibilities and obligations, including statutory obligations, and ensuring all payroll systems comply with national tax laws.

  •  Attending to any payroll-related queries or questions from employees.

  • Direct, manage and maintain contact with internal and external “client/customers” for feedback and to obtain client/customer satisfaction

Knowledge Skill and Experience

  •  Minimum of 1 to 2 years of extensive experience in Payroll.

  • Exposure to HR Tools and should have dealt with ADP(vendor) added advantage.

  •  Should have exposure of handling HR, Payroll, and allied activities.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook.

  • . Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
